items.title: 美債殖利率飆升 股市感受壓力前企業信用市場恐先出現裂痕
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Stock Market Feels Pressure, Corporate Credit Market May Show Cracks First
paras: 華爾街原本希望上周的債市暴跌已經是最糟糕的情況，但周一(28日)的市場表現顯示情況可能並非如此，美國公債殖利率續升至多年高點。這不只打壓股市，也影響美國消費者與企業在房貸、汽車貸款及信用卡債務等各種借貸上的成本。
10年期美債殖利率周一周一盤中一度升至5.27%，收盤報5.241%，創2007年6月以來新高，30年期殖利率也上升6個基點至5.561%，創24年新高。兩者均已連續五個交易日走升。
經歷艱難的上周後，美國債市周一並未擺脫「不妙的9月」，公債市場可能創下多年來最差的單月表現：9月以來，10年期殖利率已上升近48個基點，30年期殖利率則上升31個基點。

油價與升息預期 雙重力量推升殖利率

美債殖利率最新一波升勢，主因是周末有報導指出川普拒絕伊朗提出的停火方案，並預料在美國11月期中選舉後再次轟炸伊朗，這使油價應聲上漲，進一步鞏固通膨升溫和升息預期。
能源價格上漲，促使長天期債券持有人要求更高殖利率，以補償額外的不確定性，在此同時，市場預期聯準會(Fed)將進一步升息，也對短天期債券構成壓力。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，聯準基金期貨交易員目前押注Fed 10月再升息1碼(25個基點)的機率接近75%，12月再升息的機率則為60%。
近期殖利率上升是多重因素共同發揮作用的結果，除了油價、通膨和升息預期以外，美國政府和人工智慧(AI)企業大量發債也是助長力量。此外，由於AI建設讓美國經濟強勁成長，投資人對債券的需求有所下滑。

小型股與殖利率敏感類股首當其衝

近期殖利率上升對小型股打擊尤其嚴重，其他對殖利率特別敏感的股市領域，如公用事業及營建商，也受到衝擊。即使是被視為不確定性時期經典避險資產的黃金，在近期大漲後也開始走弱。
投資人已注意到，債市波動率不斷升高，但股市相對平靜，兩者之間出現明顯背離。
Clark Capital Management Group固定收益主管Oliver Chambers接受MarketWatch電話訪問時表示：「我們應該開始看到股市對此做出反應。每當殖利率跳升50個基點，就應該開始對股市形成壓力。目前兩者的反應並不完全一致。」

企業信用市場恐先感受到壓力

然而，在股市真正感受到壓力之前，企業信用市場的債券可能已因大量發債而面臨壓力。
根據Glenmede彙整的數據，2026年美國公債與企業債券發行量預估將達到接近8兆美元的紀錄高點。AI超大規模資料中心業者(hyperscalers)今年來已發行約2470億美元債務，是2024年的12倍以上。
Glenmede投資策略與研究主管Jason Pride及投資策略副總裁Michael Reynolds說：「隨著政府與企業尋求融資，市場正在吸收前所未有的發債量，加劇對稀缺資本的競爭。」
Glenmede策略師團隊指出，儘管融資需求大幅增加，可用於滿足這些需求的儲蓄資金池成長速度卻慢得多，因此金融資產供給成長速度已超過可供吸收這些資產的資本。因此投資人可能要求更高的報酬，以換取資金。
他們補充指出：「這種更高的必要報酬，可能轉化為更低的資產價格，以及更高的未來預期報酬。」
paras_en: Wall Street had hoped that last week's bond market plunge was the worst it would see, but Monday's (the 28th) market performance suggests the situation may be even worse, as U.S. Treasury yields continued to climb to multi‑year highs. This not only drags down equities but also raises the cost of borrowing for U.S. consumers and businesses on mortgages, auto loans and credit‑card debt.

The 10‑year Treasury yield spiked to 5.27% intraday on Monday and closed at 5.241%, a peak not seen since June 2007, while the 30‑year yield rose six basis points to 5.561%, a 24‑year high. Both have risen for five consecutive trading days.

After a tough week, the U.S. bond market on Monday did not shake off a "troubled September," and the Treasury market may be posting its worst monthly performance in years: since September, the 10‑year yield has climbed nearly 48 basis points and the 30‑year yield up 31 basis points.

Higher oil prices and rate‑hike expectations are the twin forces pushing yields higher. The latest rally in Treasury yields was sparked by weekend reports that former President Trump rejected Iran's cease‑fire proposal and is expected to resume bombing Iran after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November, sending oil prices soaring and reinforcing inflation‑rise and rate‑hike expectations.

Rising energy prices are prompting long‑duration bond holders to demand higher yields to compensate for added uncertainty, while market expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep raising rates are also putting pressure on short‑duration bonds.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, futures traders are currently betting that the Fed will raise rates by another 25‑basis‑point “step” in October with a probability close to 75%, and that a December hike has about a 60% chance.

The recent yield rise is the result of multiple factors working together; beyond oil, inflation and rate‑hike expectations, massive issuance by the U.S. government and AI companies is also fueling the move. Moreover, AI‑driven economic strength is dampening investors’ demand for bonds.

Small‑cap stocks and yield‑sensitive sectors are hit first. The recent yield climb has been especially painful for small‑cap stocks, and other yield‑sensitive areas such as utilities and builders have also felt the impact. Even gold, the classic safe‑haven in uncertain times, has begun to weaken after a recent rally.
Investors have noted that bond‑market volatility is rising steadily while the equity market remains relatively calm, creating a clear divergence between the two.

Oliver Chambers, head of fixed income at Clark Capital Management Group, told MarketWatch by phone: "We should start seeing the equity market react. Every time yields jump 50 basis points, pressure on stocks should begin to build. So far the reactions haven’t been fully aligned,"
Corporate credit markets may feel the pressure first, even before the equity market does, as a flood of new issuance could strain them.

Glenmede’s compiled data projects that U.S. Treasury and corporate bond issuance in 2026 will approach a record $8 trillion. AI hyperscalers have issued about $247 billion of debt this year, more than 12 times the amount issued in 2024.

Jason Pride, head of investment strategy and research at Glenmede, and investment strategy VP Michael Reynolds said, "As governments and corporations seek financing, the market is absorbing an unprecedented volume of issuance, intensifying competition for scarce capital."

Glenmede strategists note that although financing demand has surged, the pool of savings available to meet that demand is growing far more slowly, so the supply of financial assets now outpaces the capital able to absorb them, prompting investors to demand higher returns for providing funds.
They added, "This higher required return could translate into lower asset prices and higher expected future returns."

items.title: 特納斯上任就動刀！蘋果擬打破春秋兩季發表新品慣例
items.title_en: Ternus Moves Quickly After Taking the Helm! Apple Plans to Break Its Spring and Fall Product Launch Tradition
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)上任數周後，已著手研議調整產品開發與組織架構，希望加快新品推出速度、擴大裝置陣容，並精簡管理層級。這些構想顯示，曾掌管硬體工程的特納斯，正試圖改變蘋果在庫克(Tim Cook)領導15年間建立的運作方式。
外媒周二(29日)引述知情人士報導，特納斯已在內部討論減少依賴春、秋兩季發表新品的慣例，改為全年更頻繁地推出產品。他認為，在人工智慧(AI)時代，蘋果必須加快開發並勇於嘗試新產品。不過，員工指出，改變行之多年的開發流程並不容易，可能需要數年才能完成。

加快新品節奏 精簡管理層級

蘋果明年規畫推出多款新裝置，包括配備相機的AirPods、首款智慧眼鏡，以及紀念iPhone問世20周年的重新設計機型。更密集的產品時程，也讓開發團隊面臨壓力。知情人士形容，主管如今更直接參與開發工作，團隊被要求在更短時間內推出更多產品。
在人事方面，蘋果硬體工程部門過去兩周已通知部分工程專案經理離職，受影響者包括約六名總監級員工。這些專案經理長期負責掌握開發時程、協調跨團隊工作。受影響員工只有數周時間尋找公司內部其他職位，未能轉任者將於今年稍晚遭到裁員。蘋果近月也縮減Siri、Vision Pro及部分AI軟體團隊，並提早收掉對營收貢獻較低的開發計畫。
特納斯也在探索如何以AI加快產品開發、處理部分員工工作。蘋果今年夏天曾研議裁撤約5,000名AppleCare客服人員，評估讓AI客服接手部分業務，但最終暫停該計畫，目前沒有執行打算。

服務成長放緩 尋找新收入

精簡組織之外，特納斯也與服務業務主管克佑(Eddy Cue)、財務長帕雷克(Kevan Parekh)討論推出新服務，並提高現有產品的收入。蘋果服務業務仍較去年同期成長，但今年第二季營收較前一季下滑，為2022年以來首見季減；App Store的營運模式也承受壓力。
零組件成本同樣增加。全球記憶體供應吃緊推高蘋果的採購支出，儘管公司已調漲部分產品價格，仍須自行吸收部分成本，以免漲價幅度嚇退顧客。對特納斯而言，更頻繁地推出新品，既能帶動裝置銷售，也可能為新服務吸引使用者，但組織調整與成本控管仍將持續。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) new CEO John Ternus, just weeks into his tenure, has already begun discussing adjustments to product development and organizational structure, aiming to speed up new product releases, expand the device lineup, and streamline management layers. These ideas show that Ternus, who previously oversaw hardware engineering, is trying to change the operating model Apple has built over Tim Cook’s 15‑year leadership.

Foreign media on Tuesday (the 29th) quoted insiders saying Ternus is discussing internally reducing reliance on the traditional spring and fall product launches, shifting to more frequent releases throughout the year. He believes that in the AI era Apple must accelerate development and be bold in trying new products. However, employees note that altering a decades‑long development process won’t be easy and could take several years to complete.

Accelerating the product cadence and flattening management layers Apple plans to roll out multiple new devices next year, including camera‑equipped AirPods, its first smart glasses, and a redesigned model to mark the iPhone’s 20th anniversary. The tighter schedule puts pressure on development teams. Insiders say managers are now more directly involved in the work, and teams are being asked to deliver more products in shorter timeframes.

On the personnel side, Apple’s hardware engineering division has notified several project managers of termination over the past two weeks, affecting about six director‑level employees. These managers have long been responsible for tracking development timelines and coordinating cross‑team work. Affected staff have only a few weeks to find other internal roles; those who cannot be reassigned will be laid off later this year. Apple has also recently trimmed Siri, Vision Pro, and parts of its AI software teams, and has prematurely shut down lower‑revenue development projects.

Ternus is also exploring how AI can speed up product development and handle some employee tasks. This summer Apple considered cutting roughly 5,000 AppleCare support staff and evaluating AI‑driven customer service, but the plan was paused and there are currently no implementation plans.

Beyond organizational slimming, Ternus has been discussing new services and ways to boost revenue from existing products with services chief Eddy Cue and CFO Kevin Parekh. Apple’s services business still grew year‑over‑year, but second‑quarter revenue fell versus the prior quarter—the first quarterly decline since 2022—and the App Store’s operating model is under pressure.

Component costs are also rising. Global memory shortages have pushed Apple’s procurement expenses higher; even though the company has raised prices on some products, it still absorbs part of the cost to avoid scaring customers with steep price hikes. For Ternus, more frequent product launches can drive device sales and attract users to new services, but organizational adjustments and cost control will remain ongoing challenges.

items.title: 油價漲、Fed恐再升息！美債遭拋售 30年期公債殖利率創24年新高
items.title_en: Oil Prices Rise, Fed May Hike Again! US Bonds Sold Off as 30-Year Treasury Yield Hits 24-Year High
paras: 美國公債賣壓持續升溫，30年期公債殖利率周二(29日)連續第六個交易日攀升，一度觸及5.613%，創2002年以來最高。中東戰事推高能源價格，市場憂心通膨再起、聯準會(Fed)繼續升息；企業債發行增加及美國財政疑慮，也加重債市壓力。
截稿前，30年期公債殖利率盤中報5.609%，較前一交易日上升約4個基點。10年期公債殖利率升至約5.285%，處於2007年以來高檔；2年期殖利率約4.922%。公債價格與殖利率走勢相反。
美伊戰爭已持續約七個月，油價居高不下，使投資人擔心物價壓力延續。本月Fed以12比0全員一致升息1碼後，交易員目前押注10月會議再次升息的機率超過72%。美國經濟活動強勁及政府債務規模，也讓公債殖利率進一步走高。
這波跌勢不只衝擊長天期公債。根據《彭博》指數，美國公債今年迄今下跌2.6%，相較去年上漲6.3%。花旗策略師形容，債市正經歷「輕度買方罷工」；知名美國獨立金融市場與總體經濟研究機構雅迪尼研究(Yardeni Research)則認為，以日元融資投資高收益資產的套利交易平倉，也助長全球債券拋售。
季節因素可能使賣壓延續。過去十年，美國公債9月跌幅中位數為0.9%，10月為0.7%。道明證券策略師Prashant Newnaha警告，若中東局勢遲遲無法化解，固定收益市場可能持續降低風險部位，賣壓甚至蔓延至股市。道富投資管理公司策略師Masahiko Loo指出，秋季公債供給回升，加上企業發債與AI資本支出需求，將使資金競爭更加激烈。
不過，也有投資人認為債市已跌過頭。華爾街資深人士Jim Bianco六年來首次看好美國公債，RBC BlueBay投資長Mark Dowding則認為，全球債券遭到過度拋售。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury selling pressure continued to heat up, with the 30-year Treasury yield climbing for the sixth consecutive trading day on Tuesday (the 29th), briefly reaching 5.613% – the highest level since 2002. The Middle East conflict has pushed energy prices higher, sparking market worries about a resurgence of inflation and further Fed rate hikes; increased corporate bond issuance and concerns over U.S. fiscal health have also added pressure to the bond market.

At the time of writing, the 30-year Treasury yield was trading at 5.609% intraday, about four basis points higher than the previous session. The 10-year yield rose to roughly 5.285%, a peak not seen since 2007, while the 2-year yield was about 4.922%. Treasury prices move inversely to yields.

The U.S.-Iran war has now lasted about seven months, and persistently high oil prices are making investors worry that price pressures will continue. After the Fed unanimously raised rates by one quarter-point this month (12‑0 vote), traders are now betting that the October meeting will see another hike with a probability exceeding 72%. Strong U.S. economic activity and the size of government debt are also pushing Treasury yields higher.

The sell‑off is not limited to long‑dated bonds. According to Bloomberg data, U.S. Treasuries are down 2.6% year‑to‑date, compared with a 6.3% gain last year. Citi strategists described the bond market as undergoing a “mild buyer strike,” while the independent research firm Yardeni Research said that the unwinding of yen‑funded arbitrage trades into high‑yield assets is further fueling the global bond sell‑off.

Seasonal factors may keep the pressure on. Over the past decade, the median September decline for U.S. Treasuries has been 0.9% and the median October decline 0.7%. TD Securities strategist Prashant Newnaha warned that if the Middle East situation remains unresolved, the fixed‑income market could keep trimming risk positions, with selling pressure potentially spilling over into equities. State Street Global Advisors strategist Masahiko Loo noted that autumn Treasury supply is picking up, and combined with corporate issuance and AI‑driven capital spending, competition for funding will intensify.

Nevertheless, some investors think the bond market has oversold. Wall Street veteran Jim Bianco is bullish on U.S. Treasuries for the first time in six years, and RBC BlueBay’s chief investment officer Mark Dowding believes global bonds have been sold off excessively.

items.title: 美國8月職缺降至5個月低點！低裁員撐住就業 Fed仍有升息空間
items.title_en: U.S. August Job Openings Drop to Five-Month Low; Low Layoffs Support Employment, Fed Still Has Rate‑Hike Room
paras: 美國8月職缺降至五個月低點，連續第三個月不如市場預期，但裁員人數也降至2025年3月以來最低，招聘則小幅回升，顯示勞動市場仍處於「低招聘、低裁員」格局。企業擴編意願雖偏弱，卻未出現大規模裁員，讓聯準會(Fed)仍有空間優先對抗通膨。
美國勞工統計局周二(29日)公布職缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)，8月職缺減少25.6萬個至707.9萬個，低於市場預估的約722萬個。7月數據由727.1萬個上修至733.5萬個，8月職缺率則從4.4%降至4.3%。

職缺縮減遍及多個產業 求職與轉職機會收窄

職缺減少涵蓋專業與商業服務、醫療與社會援助、州與地方政府，以及製造業和營建業；貿易、資訊、休閒與餐旅業則增加。其中，房地產與租賃業職缺銳減近半至5萬個，創2014年2月以來最低，顯示部分產業用人需求明顯轉弱。
每名失業者對應的職缺數，也由7月約1.1個降至約1個，遠低於2022年高峰的2個。這項Fed密切追蹤的指標，反映勞動供需大致平衡，但也意味求職者不再擁有過去那麼多選擇。
8月主動離職人數減少2.3萬人至306.6萬人，離職率維持1.9%，追平2020年以來最低，反映勞工對找到更好工作的信心不足。企業招聘意願偏低，使在職者不敢輕易跳槽，待業者也更難進入市場。同日公布的9月消費者信心降至2014年以來最低，民眾對就業前景也更悲觀。

低裁員支撐就業穩定 Fed仍有升息空間

不過，求職難度增加，尚未演變成裁員潮。8月招聘增加4.6萬人至519.2萬人，招聘率由3.2%升至3.3%；裁員與解僱減少6.1萬人至164.1萬人，相關比率從1.1%降至1%。初領失業救濟金人數也維持歷史低檔附近，顯示企業仍傾向留住現有人力。
經濟學家認為，美伊戰爭帶來的不確定性，是企業不願擴大招聘的原因之一。能源價格攀升推高通膨，柴油價格更創歷史新高，恐進一步拖累經濟。這使Fed面臨兩面考驗：招聘疲弱值得留意，但低裁員與穩定的失業率，仍讓官員有餘裕處理物價壓力。
Fed本月升息1碼，將基準利率調至3.75%至4%，為三年來首次升息，並暗示後續可能續升。根據芝商所FedWatch工具數據，市場押注10月再升息的機率約70.3%。
周五(10/2)公布的9月非農就業報告，將進一步檢驗勞動市場韌性。市場預估新增就業9萬人，低於8月的16.2萬人，失業率則維持4.1%。若招聘放緩卻未推升失業率，Fed仍有理由聚焦通膨；若就業明顯惡化，後續升息的取捨就會更複雜。不過，JOLTS回覆率較疫情前明顯下降，且與非農統計口徑不同，仍須搭配其他數據判讀，不能僅憑職缺減少就斷言就業將失速。
paras_en: U.S. August job openings fell to a five‑month low, marking the third consecutive month they missed market expectations, while layoffs also fell to their lowest level since March 2025 and hiring rebounded slightly, indicating the labor market remains in a "low hiring, low layoffs" pattern. Although firms' willingness to expand is weak, there has been no wave of large‑scale layoffs, leaving the Federal Reserve room to prioritize fighting inflation.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on Tuesday (the 29th). August job openings declined by 256,000 to 7.079 million, below the market forecast of roughly 7.22 million. July’s figure was revised up from 7.271 million to 7.335 million, and the August job‑opening rate fell from 4.4% to 4.3%.

Job cuts were seen across many sectors, narrowing job‑search and career‑change opportunities. Openings fell in professional and business services, health care and social assistance, state and local government, as well as manufacturing and construction, while trade, information, leisure and hospitality added jobs. Notably, real‑estate and rental openings plunged almost half to 50,000, the lowest since February 2014, showing a clear weakening in demand for workers in some industries.

The number of job openings per unemployed worker dropped from about 1.1 in July to roughly 1 in August, far below the 2022 peak of 2. This Fed‑watched indicator suggests labor supply and demand are roughly balanced, but also means job seekers no longer have as many choices as before.

August voluntary quits fell by 23,000 to 3.066 million, keeping the quit rate at 1.9%—a low tied with the post‑2020 minimum—reflecting workers’ lack of confidence in finding better jobs. Weak hiring appetite makes employed workers reluctant to switch jobs and makes the unemployed find it harder to enter the market. On the same day, September consumer confidence slid to its lowest since 2014, deepening pessimism about employment prospects.

Low layoffs are supporting employment stability, and the Fed still has room to raise rates. Yet job‑search difficulty has risen, though it has not turned into a layoff wave. August hires rose by 46,000 to 5.192 million, lifting the hiring rate from 3.2% to 3.3%; layoffs and discharges fell by 61,000 to 1.641 million, dropping the related rate from 1.1% to 1%. Initial unemployment benefit claims also stayed near historic lows, showing firms still prefer to retain existing staff.

Economists say the uncertainty from the U.S.–Iran conflict is one reason firms are reluctant to expand hiring. Rising energy prices are pushing inflation higher, with diesel hitting record highs and threatening further economic drag. This puts the Fed in a two‑sided dilemma: weak hiring warrants attention, but low layoffs and a stable unemployment rate give officials leeway to address price pressures.

The Fed raised its policy rate by one quarter‑point this month, moving the target range to 3.75%–4.00%, the first hike in three years, and signaled that further increases are possible. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market assigns roughly a 70.3% probability to another hike in October.

The September non‑farm payroll report, due Friday (Oct 2), will further test labor‑market resilience. Analysts expect 90,000 new jobs, down from August’s 162,000, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.1%. If hiring slows without pushing the unemployment rate up, the Fed can keep its focus on inflation; if employment deteriorates sharply, the calculus for further hikes becomes more complex. However, JOLTS response rates have fallen noticeably since the pandemic and its coverage differs from the payroll survey, so the data must be read alongside other indicators and not be used alone to claim that employment is about to stall.

items.title: 貿易摩擦加劇 美國對近10億美元加拿大商品進口禁令正式生效
items.title_en: Trade Friction Escalates as U.S. Ban on Nearly $1 Billion Worth of Canadian Imports Takes Effect
paras: 美國在29日（周二）凌晨起正式實施針對加拿大部分商品的進口禁令，涉及酒類、乳製品和摩托車等，預計涉及約9.67億美元加拿大對美出口。
此次禁令是川普政府對加拿大採取的一系列貿易措施的最新升級。美國與加拿大兩國年度雙邊貿易額約8,800億美元，因此此次禁令涉及的規模相對有限。
美國貿易律師帕特里克·柴爾德里斯表示，此舉不會緩解美加貿易緊張局勢。他認為，由於相關商品此前已經面臨美國加徵關稅，其中部分商品實際上已經因高關稅而難以進入美國市場。
美國智庫美國行動論壇貿易政策主管雅各布·詹森估算，此次禁令涉及的加拿大商品價值約9.67億美元，其中約87%為酒類，包括啤酒、烈酒、氣泡酒、白蘭地、清酒等。
此外，部分乳製品以及摩托車也在禁令範圍內。
加拿大此前已針對美國關稅採取反制措施。此次進口禁令可能進一步加劇美加貿易摩擦，並增添兩國圍繞《美國—墨西哥—加拿大協定》（USMCA）續簽談判的不確定性。
美加近來貿易爭端不斷。川普政府從8月22日開始對從加拿大進口的紅酒、水泥等數百項特定商品加徵50%關稅。加拿大政府隨後宣布對美國實施「等額、對等」反制，從9月8日起對價值約200億美元700多種美國商品加徵反制關稅。
據美國白宮16日發布的消息，美國總統川普當天簽署一份總統備忘錄，將源自加拿大的產品排除出美國政府採購計畫。
paras_en: On the early morning of Tuesday the 29th, the United States formally began enforcing an import ban on certain Canadian goods, covering alcohol, dairy products and motorcycles, and affecting roughly $967 million in Canadian exports to the U.S.

The ban represents the latest escalation in a series of trade measures taken by the Trump administration against Canada. With annual bilateral trade between the two countries around $880 billion, the scope of this ban is relatively modest.

U.S. trade lawyer Patrick Schilderis said the move will not ease the tension in U.S.-Canada trade relations. He noted that many of the affected products were already subject to U.S. tariffs, and some of them are effectively barred from the U.S. market because of the high duties.

Jacob Jensen, head of trade policy at the American Action Forum, estimated the value of Canadian goods covered by the ban at about $967 million, with roughly 87 % of that consisting of alcoholic beverages such as beer, spirits, sparkling wine, brandy and sake.
In addition, certain dairy products and motorcycles are also included in the ban’s scope.

Canada has previously taken retaliatory steps against U.S. tariffs. This new import ban could further heighten U.S.-Canada trade friction and add uncertainty to the ongoing negotiations over the renewal of the United States‑Mexico‑Canada Agreement (USMCA).

Recent U.S.-Canada trade disputes have been frequent. Since August 22, the Trump administration has imposed a 50 % tariff on hundreds of specific Canadian items, including red wine and cement. Canada responded by announcing “equal‑and‑reciprocal” retaliation, imposing counter‑tariffs on more than 700 U.S. products worth about $20 billion starting September 8.
According to a White House release on the 16th, President Trump signed a presidential memorandum that excludes products originating from Canada from U.S. government procurement programs.

items.title: 黃金、高收益債一起倒！交易員更看好誰反彈？
items.title_en: Gold and High‑Yield Bonds Both Crash! Which Do Traders Expect to Rebound?
paras: 美國公債殖利率持續攀升，重挫黃金與高收益公司債兩大資產，但選擇權交易透露不同押注：交易員看好黃金有望反彈，對高收益債則偏向悲觀。
美國10年期公債殖利率升至5.3%、30年期觸及5.4%，黃金下跌4%，跌至8月首周以來最低。追蹤高收益公司債的iShares iBoxx高收益公司債ETF(HYG-US)則連跌五日，降至2025年4月以來低點。
Cboe Global Markets(CBOE-US)旗下LiveVol數據顯示，周一(28日)SPDR黃金ETF(GLD-US)買權成交量約為賣權兩倍，其中推估主動買進的買權逾6.8萬口，賣權不到3.2萬口。Barchart分析顯示，淨交易情緒偏多近280萬美元，Delta方向性曝險淨額約10.5萬，同樣偏向多方。
不過，GLD買權的買進與賣出數量相近。當天最大單筆交易是賣出2,000口2028年1月到期、履約價375美元的賣權，交易金額590萬美元，可能是平倉既有空頭部位，也可能押注GLD在375美元附近築底。GLD今夏多數時間在370至380美元間震盪，賣出賣權的投資人可收取權利金，但須承擔價格下跌的風險。
兩檔ETF均與10年期公債殖利率呈高度負相關，GLD的10日相關係數為負0.8，HYG則為負0.99，但HYG選擇權交易更明顯偏空。
HYG周一選擇權成交量超過30日均量的2.5倍，賣權成交量也超過買權的2.5倍。推估主動買進的賣權約5.2萬口，買權僅逾1.5萬口。
SpotGamma數據顯示，HYG選擇權權利金交易總額約3,500萬美元，其中3,000萬美元涉及買權。不過，依買進金額排名，前12大契約有11個是賣權；按成交量排名，前10大契約有8個是賣權。最熱門的買進契約為11月20日到期、履約價78美元的賣權。
The Arora Report創辦人Nigam Arora警告，高收益債市場過度安逸，違約風險可能遠高於市場預期。他指出，許多相關債務採浮動利率，明年又將面臨到期壓力。投資人雖追求收益，但信用利差提供的補償不足，風險報酬並不吸引人，直言自己不會碰這類資產。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields kept climbing, crushing both gold and high‑yield corporate bonds, yet options trading revealed divergent bets: traders are more optimistic that gold could bounce back, while they remain pessimistic on high‑yield debt.

The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose to 5.3% and the 30‑year hit 5.4%, sending gold down 4% to its lowest level since the first week of August. The iShares iBoxx High‑Yield Corporate Bond ETF (HYG‑US), which tracks high‑yield bonds, fell for a fifth straight day, sliding to its lowest point since April 2025.

Cboe Global Markets’ LiveVol data showed that on Monday the 28th, the SPDR Gold ETF (GLD‑US) call volume was about twice the put volume, with an estimated 68,000 actively bought calls versus fewer than 32,000 puts. Barchart analysis indicated a net long sentiment of roughly $2.8 million and a net directional delta exposure of about 105,000, also skewed bullish.

However, the number of GLD calls bought and sold was close. The day’s largest single trade was the sale of 2,000 put contracts expiring in January 2028 with a $375 strike, worth $5.9 million, possibly closing existing short positions or betting that GLD would find a floor around $375. GLD has mostly traded between $370 and $380 this summer; investors who sell puts collect premium but bear the risk of a price drop.
Both ETFs are highly negatively correlated with the 10‑year Treasury yield—GLD’s 10‑day correlation coefficient is –0.8 and HYG’s is –0.99—but HYG options show a clearer bearish tilt.

HYG’s option volume on Monday was more than 2.5 times its 30‑day average, with put volume also exceeding call volume by over 2.5‑to‑1. Roughly 52,000 puts were actively bought versus just over 15,000 calls.

SpotGamma data indicated total premium traded on HYG options was about $35 million, of which $30 million involved calls. Yet, by dollar amount of purchases, 11 of the top 12 contracts were puts; by volume, 8 of the top 10 contracts were puts. The most popular purchased contract was a put expiring on November 20 with a $78 strike.

Nigam Arora, founder of The Arora Report, warned that the high‑yield bond market is overly complacent and default risk could be far higher than markets expect. He noted many of the debts are floating‑rate and will face rollover pressure next year. While investors chase yield, the credit spread compensation is insufficient, making the risk‑reward unattractive, and he stated he would stay away from such assets.

items.title: 金管會揭上半年金檢四大缺失 房貸不當搭售壽險、人頭戶防詐漏洞成焦點
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Reveals Four Major Findings from First Half 2026 Financial Inspections, Highlighting Improper Mortgage Insurance Bundling and Front‑Person Account Fraud Gaps
paras: 為維持金融檢查作業透明度並輔導業者自律，金管會今(29)日依據「金融檢查指導原則」，正式公布 2026 年度上半年金融機構主要檢查缺失及改善做法。本次檢查涵蓋金融控股公司、本國銀行、外商銀行、信合社、電支機構、投信、票券、證券及產壽險等 10 個業別，主要缺失焦點集中於「防制詐騙與洗錢」、「消費者保護」、「內部管理」及「資訊安全」四大領域。其中，銀行辦理房貸業務時是否「不當搭售房貸壽險」及「人頭戶防範」等議題，也成為關注焦點。
金管會指出，在防制洗錢與打擊資恐方面，部分金融機構存在嚴重漏洞。有客戶由「籌備處」變更為正式公司後，銀行未落實開戶審查，導致未能發現該公司符合警政署公布的人頭公司特徵，開戶後不久即遭 165 聯防通報。
此外，部分業者受理警察機關通報警示的電子支付帳戶後，未依規定第一時間通報聯徵中心；也有法人客戶已觸發多次疑似洗錢交易警示、資金快進快出且與一般公司營運模式不符，銀行卻未深入瞭解交易真實性。金管會強調，金融機構應落實開戶審查與持續交易監控，建立嚴密防線。
在消費者保護領域，金檢發現有銀行辦理房屋貸款時，未充分告知客戶可自主選擇是否投保房貸壽險，導致客戶誤以為投保為核貸的「必要條件」，甚至有業務員以「爭取較低利率」勸誘客戶投保。
對於媒體關心房貸壽險搭售情形是否嚴重，金管會檢查局副局長郭文龍回應，金檢抽查時發現有客戶在貸款諮詢的電話錄音中對利率與搭售表達疑慮，顯示銀行員在說明時未讓客戶清楚了解「擁有自主選擇權」或造成客戶誤解。郭文龍重申，金管會早已多次宣導「不得以買房貸壽險作為貸款搭售條件」，業務局後續將根據金檢報告與違規事實，評估是否進行相關處分。
此外，消保缺失還包括：業者未有效建置「客戶與理專/業務員通訊地址相同」的比對監控機制；基金廣告未平衡揭露獲利與風險；以及向非專業投資人推介具損失吸收能力(TLAC)債券等情況。
在授信與內部管理方面，金檢發現有金融機構辦理住宅及企業建築放款時，將未經主管機關核定的購地或重劃案件，逕自排除在《銀行法》第 72 條之 2 限額控管之外。
郭文龍解釋，部分都更或獎勵投資條例案件雖可依法免列入 72 條之 2 限制，但部分金融機構未經詳細查證就直接排除，顯見作業不夠審慎，已要求業者確實依規檢視資金用途。另外，金檢也發現部分機構未落實董事等利害關係人的資料申報與建檔，導致授信或交易前無法準確比對。
資訊安全為金融業運營根本，但金檢顯示，部分金融機構的對外服務網站引用了不安全的第三方函式庫；作業系統主機未建立安全強化標準，且最高權限帳號由管理人員自行持有、未納入集中管理或定期清查。
此外，行動應用程式管理也出現基本資安檢測不完整、參數設定允許明文傳輸，甚至嵌入的廠商安控軟體(SDK)含有中高風險漏洞卻未修補即上架等問題。金管會要求業者全面檢討網頁與 APP 安全設計，落實漏洞修補與帳號權限控管。
paras_en: To maintain transparency of financial inspections and guide industry self‑regulation, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) today (the 29th) announced, based on the “Financial Inspection Guidance Principles,” the main inspection deficiencies and remedial actions for financial institutions in the first half of 2026. The review covered ten sectors – financial holding companies, domestic banks, foreign banks, credit cooperatives, electronic payment firms, investment trusts, bill‑issuing companies, securities firms, and life‑insurance providers – with key issues concentrated in four areas: anti‑fraud and anti‑money‑laundering, consumer protection, internal management, and information security. Among them, whether banks improperly bundled mortgage life insurance with home‑loan products and the handling of “front‑person” accounts became focal points.

The FSC noted serious gaps in anti‑money‑laundering and counter‑terror‑financing controls at some institutions. In one case, a client that transitioned from a “pre‑incorporation” stage to a formal company was allowed to open an account without proper due‑diligence, despite matching the police‑defined characteristics of a front‑person company; the account was flagged shortly after opening by the 165 Joint Prevention Hotline.

Furthermore, some firms failed to promptly report electronic‑payment accounts flagged by police alerts to the Credit Information Center as required, and corporate clients that triggered multiple suspicious‑transaction alerts – showing rapid inflows and outflows inconsistent with normal business operations – were not thoroughly investigated by the banks. The FSC stressed that institutions must enforce rigorous account opening checks and continuous transaction monitoring to build a strong defensive line.

In the consumer‑protection domain, inspections found that certain banks did not adequately inform borrowers that purchasing mortgage life insurance was optional, leading customers to mistakenly believe it was a prerequisite for loan approval. Some sales staff even urged clients to buy the insurance by promising lower interest rates.

Addressing media concerns about the severity of mortgage‑insurance bundling, FSC Inspection Bureau Deputy Director Guo Wen‑long said that spot checks revealed callers expressing doubts about interest rates and bundling during loan‑consultation calls, indicating that bank staff failed to clearly convey customers’ right to choose or caused misunderstandings. Guo reiterated that the FSC has repeatedly warned that “mortgage life insurance must not be used as a condition for loan approval,” and the Business Bureau will assess whether to impose penalties based on inspection reports and any violations.

Other consumer‑protection shortcomings include the lack of a monitoring mechanism to match customers’ contact addresses with those of their financial advisers or sales staff, fund advertisements that do not balance profit disclosures with risk disclosures, and the promotion of TLAC (Total Loss‑Absorbing Capacity) bonds to non‑professional investors.

Regarding credit granting and internal management, inspections discovered that some institutions excluded land‑purchase or rezoning projects not approved by regulators from the loan‑amount caps stipulated in Article 72‑2 of the Banking Act when issuing residential and commercial construction loans.

Guo explained that while certain urban‑renewal or incentive‑investment projects can be lawfully exempt from the Article 72‑2 limit, some banks excluded projects without thorough verification, showing insufficient diligence. The FSC has ordered firms to rigorously examine fund usage according to regulations. Additionally, the inspection found that some institutions failed to collect and file conflict‑of‑interest information for directors and related parties, hindering accurate verification before credit decisions or transactions.

Information security is fundamental to financial operations, yet the inspection showed that some institutions’ external service websites used insecure third‑party libraries; operating‑system servers lacked hardened security standards; and privileged accounts were held by individual administrators without centralized management or periodic audits.

Mobile‑app management also exhibited basic security testing gaps, allowing plaintext transmission settings, and embedded vendor SDKs contained medium‑to‑high‑risk vulnerabilities that were not patched before release. The FSC has ordered firms to comprehensively review web and app security designs, implement vulnerability remediation, and enforce strict account‑permission controls.

items.title: 美軍海上封鎖後 伊朗至中國鐵路貨運量增加十倍
items.title_en: U.S. Naval Blockade Spurs Tenfold Rise in Iran‑China Railway Freight Volume
paras: 據伊朗WANA通訊社29日（周二）報導，一位伊朗議會主席團成員表示，在美軍對伊朗實施海上封鎖後，中國至伊朗的鐵路貨運量增加了十倍。
伊朗通過鐵路等陸路路線，可以通過非海上路線每日出口約40萬桶石油。
伊朗議會主席團成員佐胡里安在談及中國至伊朗鐵路運輸量時表示，自美軍對伊朗實施海上封鎖後，經過磋商和新路線啟用，中國至伊朗的鐵路貨運量大幅增加。
佐胡里安稱，雖然鐵路運力無法完全替代海上運輸，但可以在緊急情況下列為替代路線使用，並且在正常情況也有助於確保伊朗對外貿易安全。
另據《德黑蘭時報》22日報導，伊朗貿易促進組織國際業務發展副主管阿米爾·羅尚巴赫什·甘巴里表示，伊朗正與中國就開發貨物運輸鐵路線路展開談判，部分伊朗貨物已通過伊朗中部亞茲德陸港運往中國。
paras_en: According to Iran’s WANA news agency on Tuesday the 29th, a member of the Iranian parliamentary leadership said that after the U.S. military imposed a maritime blockade on Iran, railway freight shipments from China to Iran have increased tenfold.
Iran can export roughly 400,000 barrels of oil per day via land routes such as rail, bypassing the sea.
Parliamentary leadership member Zahoorian said that, following the U.S. naval blockade, negotiations and the opening of new routes have led to a sharp rise in rail freight from China to Iran.
Zahoorian noted that while rail capacity cannot fully replace sea transport, it can serve as an alternative in emergencies and also helps safeguard Iran’s external trade under normal conditions.

According to the Tehran Times on the 22nd, Amir Roshanbakhsh Ghanbari, deputy head of international business development at Iran’s Trade Promotion Organization, said Iran is negotiating with China to develop freight‑rail corridors, and some Iranian goods have already been shipped to China via the central Iranian land port of Yazd.

金管會指出，在防制洗錢與打擊資恐方面，部分金融機構存在嚴重漏洞。有客戶由「籌備處」變更為正式公司後，銀行未落實開戶審查，導致未能發現該公司符合警政署公布的人頭公司特徵，開戶後不久即遭 165 聯防通報。
此外，部分業者受理警察機關通報警示的電子支付帳戶後，未依規定第一時間通報聯徵中心；也有法人客戶已觸發多次疑似洗錢交易警示、資金快進快出且與一般公司營運模式不符，銀行卻未深入瞭解交易真實性。金管會強調，金融機構應落實開戶審查與持續交易監控，建立嚴密防線。
在消費者保護領域，金檢發現有銀行辦理房屋貸款時，未充分告知客戶可自主選擇是否投保房貸壽險，導致客戶誤以為投保為核貸的「必要條件」，甚至有業務員以「爭取較低利率」勸誘客戶投保。
對於媒體關心房貸壽險搭售情形是否嚴重，金管會檢查局副局長郭文龍回應，金檢抽查時發現有客戶在貸款諮詢的電話錄音中對利率與搭售表達疑慮，顯示銀行員在說明時未讓客戶清楚了解「擁有自主選擇權」或造成客戶誤解。郭文龍重申，金管會早已多次宣導「不得以買房貸壽險作為貸款搭售條件」，業務局後續將根據金檢報告與違規事實，評估是否進行相關處分。
此外，消保缺失還包括：業者未有效建置「客戶與理專/業務員通訊地址相同」的比對監控機制；基金廣告未平衡揭露獲利與風險；以及向非專業投資人推介具損失吸收能力(TLAC)債券等情況。
在授信與內部管理方面，金檢發現有金融機構辦理住宅及企業建築放款時，將未經主管機關核定的購地或重劃案件，逕自排除在《銀行法》第 72 條之 2 限額控管之外。
郭文龍解釋，部分都更或獎勵投資條例案件雖可依法免列入 72 條之 2 限制，但部分金融機構未經詳細查證就直接排除，顯見作業不夠審慎，已要求業者確實依規檢視資金用途。另外，金檢也發現部分機構未落實董事等利害關係人的資料申報與建檔，導致授信或交易前無法準確比對。
資訊安全為金融業運營根本，但金檢顯示，部分金融機構的對外服務網站引用了不安全的第三方函式庫；作業系統主機未建立安全強化標準，且最高權限帳號由管理人員自行持有、未納入集中管理或定期清查。
此外，行動應用程式管理也出現基本資安檢測不完整、參數設定允許明文傳輸，甚至嵌入的廠商安控軟體(SDK)含有中高風險漏洞卻未修補即上架等問題。金管會要求業者全面檢討網頁與 APP 安全設計，落實漏洞修補與帳號權限控管。
paras_en: To maintain transparency of financial inspections and guide industry self‑regulation, the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC) today (the 29th) announced, based on the “Financial Inspection Guidance Principles,” the main inspection deficiencies and remedial actions for financial institutions in the first half of 2026. The review covered ten sectors – financial holding companies, domestic banks, foreign banks, credit cooperatives, electronic payment firms, investment trusts, bill‑issuing companies, securities firms, and life‑insurance providers – with key issues concentrated in four areas: anti‑fraud and anti‑money‑laundering, consumer protection, internal management, and information security. Among them, whether banks improperly bundled mortgage life insurance with home‑loan products and the handling of “front‑person” accounts became focal points.

The FSC noted serious gaps in anti‑money‑laundering and counter‑terror‑financing controls at some institutions. In one case, a client that transitioned from a “pre‑incorporation” stage to a formal company was allowed to open an account without proper due‑diligence, despite matching the police‑defined characteristics of a front‑person company; the account was flagged shortly after opening by the 165 Joint Prevention Hotline.

Furthermore, some firms failed to promptly report electronic‑payment accounts flagged by police alerts to the Credit Information Center as required, and corporate clients that triggered multiple suspicious‑transaction alerts – showing rapid inflows and outflows inconsistent with normal business operations – were not thoroughly investigated by the banks. The FSC stressed that institutions must enforce rigorous account opening checks and continuous transaction monitoring to build a strong defensive line.

In the consumer‑protection domain, inspections found that certain banks did not adequately inform borrowers that purchasing mortgage life insurance was optional, leading customers to mistakenly believe it was a prerequisite for loan approval. Some sales staff even urged clients to buy the insurance by promising lower interest rates.

Addressing media concerns about the severity of mortgage‑insurance bundling, FSC Inspection Bureau Deputy Director Guo Wen‑long said that spot checks revealed callers expressing doubts about interest rates and bundling during loan‑consultation calls, indicating that bank staff failed to clearly convey customers’ right to choose or caused misunderstandings. Guo reiterated that the FSC has repeatedly warned that “mortgage life insurance must not be used as a condition for loan approval,” and the Business Bureau will assess whether to impose penalties based on inspection reports and any violations.

Other consumer‑protection shortcomings include the lack of a monitoring mechanism to match customers’ contact addresses with those of their financial advisers or sales staff, fund advertisements that do not balance profit disclosures with risk disclosures, and the promotion of TLAC (Total Loss‑Absorbing Capacity) bonds to non‑professional investors.

Regarding credit granting and internal management, inspections discovered that some institutions excluded land‑purchase or rezoning projects not approved by regulators from the loan‑amount caps stipulated in Article 72‑2 of the Banking Act when issuing residential and commercial construction loans.

Guo explained that while certain urban‑renewal or incentive‑investment projects can be lawfully exempt from the Article 72‑2 limit, some banks excluded projects without thorough verification, showing insufficient diligence. The FSC has ordered firms to rigorously examine fund usage according to regulations. Additionally, the inspection found that some institutions failed to collect and file conflict‑of‑interest information for directors and related parties, hindering accurate verification before credit decisions or transactions.

Information security is fundamental to financial operations, yet the inspection showed that some institutions’ external service websites used insecure third‑party libraries; operating‑system servers lacked hardened security standards; and privileged accounts were held by individual administrators without centralized management or periodic audits.

Mobile‑app management also exhibited basic security testing gaps, allowing plaintext transmission settings, and embedded vendor SDKs contained medium‑to‑high‑risk vulnerabilities that were not patched before release. The FSC has ordered firms to comprehensively review web and app security designs, implement vulnerability remediation, and enforce strict account‑permission controls.

items.title: AI PCB資本合作升級！Amazon砸15.9億元入股金像電，79億元新廠CapEx同步啟動
items.title_en: AI PCB Capital Partnership Upgrade! Amazon Invests NT$1.589 Billion in Jinxiang Electronics, NT$7.9 Billion New Plant CapEx Launched Simultaneously
paras: 2026年09月29日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI伺服器需求持續帶動PCB供應鏈擴產，金像電(2368-TW)29日公告，Amazon將以策略投資人身分參與私募，認購185萬6,308股，每股856元，估算投資金額約15.89億元。金像電同日也核准79億元新廠土地、建廠及設備投資，預計自2026年第4季起陸續投入。
此次私募參考價格為每股1,070元，實際認購價856元，相當於參考價的80%；若與金像電29日收盤價1,120元相比，認購價低約23.6%。不過，本次私募對象限定為策略性投資人，相關股票原則上自交付日起三年內不得自由轉讓。
金像電目前已切入AWS Trainium伺服器供應鏈，Trainium 3預計於2026年第3季量產，法人預期AWS相關產品將自第3季開始放量，並帶動下半年出貨攀升。
在既有供應鏈合作基礎上，Amazon進一步透過私募成為策略投資人，使雙方關係從產品供應延伸至資本合作。市場後續將關注Amazon入股後，是否進一步帶動Trainium伺服器、高速網通及資料中心相關PCB訂單。
金像電同日核准的79億元投資中，土地預算約38億元，建廠及設備資本支出約41億元，資金來源規畫透過無擔保可轉換公司債支應。

paras_en: September 29, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Continuing demand for AI servers is driving expansion in the PCB supply chain. Jinxiang Electronics (2368‑TW) announced on the 29th that Amazon will participate in a private placement as a strategic investor, subscribing to 1,856,308 shares at NT$856 per share, an estimated investment of about NT$1.589 billion. On the same day, Jinxiang also approved a NT$7.9 billion investment for land, construction and equipment for a new plant, expected to be rolled out starting in Q4 2026.

The reference price for this private placement was NT$1,070 per share, but the actual subscription price was NT$856, roughly 80% of the reference price; compared with Jinxiang’s closing price of NT$1,120 on the 29th, the subscription price is about 23.6% lower. However, the private placement is limited to strategic investors, and the shares are generally restricted from free transfer for three years from the delivery date.

Jinxiang has already entered the AWS Trainium server supply chain, with Trainium 3 slated for mass production in Q3 2026. Analysts expect AWS‑related products to ramp up from Q3 onward, boosting shipments in the second half of the year.

Building on existing supply‑chain cooperation, Amazon’s private‑placement investment makes it a strategic shareholder, extending the relationship from product supply to capital partnership. The market will watch whether Amazon’s stake further drives orders for Trainium servers, high‑speed networking, and data‑center‑related PCBs.

Of the NT$7.9 billion approved investment, about NT$3.8 billion is allocated for land acquisition and roughly NT$4.1 billion for plant construction and equipment. The funding is planned to be sourced through unsecured convertible corporate bonds.

items.title: H1科學園區營收年增29.27%創同期新高 國科會：受惠AI、雲端需求爆發性成長
items.title_en: H1 Science Park Revenue Up 29.27% YoY, Hits Record High; Council Highlights Explosive Growth from AI and Cloud Demand
paras: 國科會於今(29)日宣布，今(2026)年上半年受惠全球AI應用持續深化及高效能運算(HPC)技術加速發展，催生AI晶片與雲端服務的爆發性需求，驅動半導體業迎來成長浪潮，科學園區上半年營收達3.54兆元、年增29.27%，再創歷史同期新高。其中竹科營收1.12兆元、年增36.03%表現最佳；中科0.65兆元、年增20.63%；南科1.77兆元、年增28.57%。
科學園區2026年上半年營業額3.54兆元，較同期成長29.27%，再創歷史新高，其中竹科1.12兆元，較2025年上半年成長36.03%；中科0.65兆元，成長20.63%；南科1.77兆元，成長28.57%。’
國科會指出，進一步分析各產業成長情形，園區共六大產業也全面成長，積體電路產業在高效能運算(HPC)與AI應用需求帶動下，營收年增29.57%；光電產業雖然面板出貨動能放緩，但憑藉光纖通訊模組訂單增加，及不斷電系統銷售持續成長，營收平穩成長6.3%；電腦及周邊產業受惠AI應用深化及雲端服務需求強勁，帶動伺服器及相關週邊設備出貨動能豐沛，推升整體營收大幅成長82.49%。
精密機械產業同樣搭上AI應用浪潮及全球半導體相關產業擴展熱絡，帶動精密設備、自動化系統及精密元組件需求，年增37.65%；生物技術產業因醫療器材及新藥行銷策略發酵，加上CDMO(委託開發暨製造服務)專案顯著挹注效益，使營收年增17.44%；通訊產業則受惠主流網路通訊設備規格轉換動能，帶動上游關鍵元件銷售成長，年增13.01%。
展望下半年，國科會指出，全球經濟雖仍受地緣政治風險與全球貿易關稅成本轉嫁的雙重考驗，但在AI應用浪潮持續推升及半導體先進製程的優勢下，園區廠商將透過強化供應鏈韌性、深化客戶夥伴關係，全面提升全球市場的戰略競爭力。
國科會強調，目前參酌科學園區上半年營運趨勢及各大研究機構預測2026年經濟成長率，預估2026全年營業額將可交出亮眼的成績單。
paras_en: The Council of Science and Technology announced today (the 29th) that the first half of 2026 benefited from the deepening of global AI applications and the accelerated development of high‑performance computing (HPC) technology, sparking explosive demand for AI chips and cloud services and driving a growth wave in the semiconductor industry. Science park revenue reached NT$3.54 trillion in the first half, up 29.27% year‑over‑year, setting a new historical high for the same period. Among the parks, Hsinchu Science Park posted NT$1.12 trillion, up 36.03% and the best performer; Central Taiwan Science Park recorded NT$0.65 trillion, up 20.63%; and Southern Taiwan Science Park generated NT$1.77 trillion, up 28.57%.

Science park revenue for the first half of 2026 was NT$3.54 trillion, a 29.27% increase over the same period last year, again a historic high. Hsinchu contributed NT$1.12 trillion, up 36.03% from the first half of 2025; Central Taiwan added NT$0.65 trillion, up 20.63%; and Southern Taiwan posted NT$1.77 trillion, up 28.57%.

The Council noted that, when breaking down growth by sector, all six major industries in the park expanded. The integrated circuit sector, driven by HPC and AI demand, saw revenue rise 29.57% year‑over‑year. The optoelectronics sector, despite a slowdown in panel shipments, maintained steady growth of 6.3% thanks to increased fiber‑optic communication module orders and continued sales of uninterruptible power systems. The computer and peripherals sector benefited from deeper AI applications and strong cloud service demand, boosting server and related peripheral shipments and lifting overall revenue by a striking 82.49%.

The precision machinery sector also rode the AI wave and the global expansion of semiconductor‑related industries, driving demand for precision equipment, automation systems and precision components, resulting in a 37.65% revenue increase. The biotechnology sector saw a 17.44% rise as medical device and new‑drug marketing strategies matured and CDMO (contract development and manufacturing organization) projects delivered significant benefits. The communications sector benefited from a shift in mainstream network equipment specifications, spurring growth in upstream key component sales and delivering a 13.01% increase.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, the Council said that although the global economy still faces the dual challenges of geopolitical risks and the pass‑through of worldwide trade‑tariff costs, the ongoing AI wave and the advantages of advanced semiconductor processes will enable park firms to strengthen supply‑chain resilience and deepen customer‑partner relationships, thereby enhancing their strategic competitiveness in global markets.

The Council emphasized that, based on the first‑half operating trends of the science parks and forecasts from major research institutions for 2026 economic growth, the full‑year 2026 revenue is expected to deliver an impressive performance.

items.title: 北市府率12家台企訪「新加坡科技周」 展AI整合實力拓展東南亞商機
items.title_en: Taipei City Government Leads 12 Taiwanese Companies to Singapore Tech Week, Showcasing AI Integration Strength to Expand Southeast Asian Opportunities
paras: 台北市產發局繼去(2025)年參展取得豐碩成果後，連續第2年再訪面向東南亞的高口碑展會「2026新加坡科技周」，於本(9)月29日、30日在外貿協會協助下，攜手12家北市科技產業設「台北主題館」，以「Smart Tech.Innovative Taipei」為主軸，對新加坡及東南亞市場展現對AI與智慧解決方案的需求，展現從產業從運算設備、資料治理到終端應用的軟硬整合實力，透過現場洽談及展後追蹤，協助企業拓展國際合作商機。
目前新加坡持續推動「智慧國家2.0」，帶動數位基礎設施、資安防護、企業數位轉型及AI應用需求。依新加坡官方統計，2025年台星商品貿易總額約1,700億星幣(約1,310億美元)，加上台灣為新加坡最大商品貿易夥伴，雙方產業優勢互補，也使新加坡成為台北企業鏈結東南亞市場的重要節點。
此次新加坡科技周整合雲端與AI基礎設施、DevOps、資安、大數據與AI及資料中心等五大專業展，匯聚眾多具影響力的企業技術決策者與具競爭力的解決方案業者。本次臺北主題館依技術鏈與應用需求，將12家企業整合為「智慧運算與感知」、「資料治理與安全」及「智慧應用與服務」三大展示面向，從基礎算力、數據管理延伸至商務服務與人才培訓，呈現台北AI產業的完整解決方案，讓國際買主可快速掌握合作方向。
在「智慧運算與感知」面向，輔信科技與展嘉科技以高算力邊緣運算設備支援即時運算需求；光影立方展出裸眼3D顯示技術；愛比科技與英晟電子整合智慧影音及傳輸系統；皓博科技則以AI設備感知與預測維護方案，協助企業掌握設備狀態及營運風險。
在「資料治理與安全」面向，核桃運算、精誠(6214-TW)資訊及叡揚資訊(6752-TW)分別展出數據平台、資安防禦及雲端碳管理方案；「智慧應用與服務」則由以力科技、優必達及阿特發科技帶來對話式商務平台、互動式虛擬人與XR培訓平台，展現AI技術在企業決策、商務服務及人才培訓等場域的應用潛力。

北市產發局表示，台北具備完整的資通訊研發能量與AI產業鏈，新加坡則是鏈結東南亞市場的重要門戶，雙方在智慧科技與數位轉型領域具高度合作潛力，繼2025年初次參加即促成約2,500萬美元的潛在商機，今年持續拓展耕耘新加坡及東南亞市場，本次參展除展現臺北企業及科技產品的軟硬整合優勢，亦透過強化買主邀約及展後追蹤，協助企業將展會接觸轉化為可持續推進的合作機會，深化與東南亞夥伴的合作關係，共同開拓數位轉型市場契機。
paras_en: The Taipei City Department of Economic Development, after achieving fruitful results at last year’s exhibition, returned for the second consecutive year to the highly regarded Southeast‑Asia‑focused event “2026 Singapore Tech Week.” With the help of the Taiwan External Trade Development Council, twelve Taipei‑based tech firms set up a “Taipei Theme Pavilion” on September 29‑30, centered on “Smart Tech. Innovative Taipei,” to demonstrate the demand for AI and smart solutions in Singapore and the broader Southeast Asian market. The pavilion highlighted end‑to‑end integration from computing hardware and data governance to terminal applications, using on‑site meetings and post‑event follow‑up to help companies expand international partnership opportunities.

Singapore is currently advancing its “Smart Nation 2.0” agenda, driving demand for digital infrastructure, cybersecurity, corporate digital transformation and AI applications. According to official Singapore statistics, total trade in Taiwanese‑Singaporean goods reached about S$170 billion (approximately US$131 billion) in 2025. With Taiwan being Singapore’s largest goods‑trade partner, the complementary strengths of the two economies make Singapore a key node for Taipei firms to connect with the Southeast Asian market.

The Singapore Tech Week this year combined five professional exhibition tracks—cloud and AI infrastructure, DevOps, cybersecurity, big data and AI, and data centers—drawing numerous influential corporate technology decision‑makers and competitive solution providers. The Taipei Theme Pavilion organized the twelve participating companies into three showcase categories—“Intelligent Computing and Sensing,” “Data Governance and Security,” and “Smart Applications and Services”—aligned with technology stacks and application needs. From foundational compute power and data management to business services and talent training, the pavilion presented a complete Taipei AI industry solution suite, enabling international buyers to quickly grasp collaboration opportunities.

In the “Intelligent Computing and Sensing” segment, Fuxin Technology and Zhanjia Technology showcased high‑performance edge‑computing devices for real‑time processing; LightCube displayed naked‑eye 3D display technology; iBii Technology and Yingcheng Electronics integrated smart audio‑visual and transmission systems; and Haobo Technology offered AI‑driven equipment sensing and predictive maintenance solutions to help enterprises monitor asset status and operational risks.

In the “Data Governance and Security” segment, Walnut Computing, Jingcheng Information (6214‑TW) and Ruiyang Information (6752‑TW) exhibited a data platform, cybersecurity defense, and cloud carbon‑management solutions respectively. The “Smart Applications and Services” segment featured Yili Technology, Youbida, and Artifex Technology presenting conversational business platforms, interactive virtual humans, and XR training platforms, demonstrating AI’s potential in corporate decision‑making, business services, and talent development.

The Taipei City Department of Economic Development noted that Taipei possesses a complete ICT R&D capability and AI industry chain, while Singapore serves as a crucial gateway to the Southeast Asian market. The two sides have strong cooperative potential in smart technology and digital transformation. After the 2025 debut generated roughly US$25 million in potential deals, this year’s participation continues to cultivate the Singapore and Southeast Asian markets. The exhibition not only showcased Taipei firms’ hardware‑software integration advantages but also strengthened buyer invitations and post‑event follow‑up, helping companies turn exhibition contacts into sustainable collaborations, deepening partnerships with Southeast Asian allies and jointly exploring digital‑transformation market opportunities.

items.title: 原料行情續揚惟下游需求仍偏弱 豐興鋼筋盤價止漲轉平
items.title_en: Raw Material Prices Keep Rising but Downstream Demand Remains Weak; Fengxing Rebar Plate Stops Rising and Turns Flat
paras: 鋼筋廠豐興(2015-TW)今(29)日開出本周盤價，雖然廢鋼報價續漲，但因需求仍偏弱，因此本周廢鋼收購價開出平盤，鋼筋也轉為平盤。
國際原料行情來看，美國大船廢鋼本週無報價，日本2H廢鋼本週上漲5美元至每公噸363美元，美國貨櫃廢鋼本週報價上漲4美元至每公噸348美元，澳洲鐵礦砂由每公噸98.2美元下跌至95.85美元。
豐興表示，上週調漲鋼筋後，市場反應溫和，主要因需求仍偏弱，客戶僅採購部分所需，但因]上游原料報價續漲，鋼筋價格易漲難跌，考量實際成交狀況下，故決議本週盤價以平盤開出。
盤價持平下，豐興廢鋼收購價每公噸9800元，鋼筋基每公噸1.83萬元，型鋼基價同樣維持每公噸2.5萬元。
paras_en: Rebar manufacturer Fengxing (2015‑TW) released this week’s price list today (the 29th). Although scrap‑steel prices continued to rise, demand remains weak, so the scrap‑steel purchase price was set flat for the week and rebar also turned flat.

Looking at international raw‑material markets, there was no quote for large U.S. bulk scrap steel this week; Japanese 2H scrap steel rose $5 to $363 per metric ton, U.S. container scrap steel rose $4 to $348 per metric ton, and Australian iron‑ore fines fell from $98.2 to $95.85 per metric ton.

Fengxing said that after raising rebar prices last week, market reaction was moderate, mainly because demand is still weak and customers only purchase part of their needs. However, with upstream raw‑material prices continuing to rise, rebar prices tend to go up rather than down. Considering the actual transaction situation, they decided to set this week’s price list flat.

With the price list flat, Fengxing’s scrap‑steel purchase price is NT$9,800 per metric ton, the base price for rebar is NT$18,300 per metric ton, and the base price for shaped steel remains at NT$25,000 per metric ton.

paras_en: Taiwan's stock market today (the 29th) was the first trading day after the long weekend. The index opened lower and fluctuated amid weakness in heavyweight electronics stocks, ending down 392.64 points or 0.82% at 47,631.96, breaking below the 5‑day moving average and the 48,000‑point level. Trading volume was NT$7.85 trillion. Foreign investors sold a net NT$63.201 billion, with the biggest net sells in Yuanta Taiwan 50 (0050‑TW) and the active ETF China Trust Taiwan Yield (00406A‑TW), each exceeding 60,000 shares (68,000 and 62,000 respectively).

Looking at the daily capital flows of the three major institutional groups, foreign investors sold a net NT$63.201 billion, marking a second consecutive day of net selling; proprietary traders switched to a net sell of NT$16.403 billion, while investment trusts remained buyers with a net purchase of NT$1.417 billion. Overall, the three groups sold a combined NT$78.187 billion. In the futures market, foreign investors increased their short positions to 79,000 contracts, close to 80,000.

(12,700 shares), Jing Yuan Electronics (12,600 shares), Taishin Shin Kong Financial (11,600 shares) and Taichung Bank (11,600 shares). They also sold 3,736 shares of TSMC.

Among investment trusts, the top ten net buys were led by United Microelectronics Corp. with 9,537 shares, followed by Formosa Plastics Corp. (8,088 shares), Yuanta Taiwan 50 (2,250 shares), Sunplus Technology (2,202 shares), Nanya Technology (1,825 shares), Yuanta Financial (1,331 shares), ChipMOS (1,050 shares), and then Evergreen Marine and Golden Eagle Electronics.

The top ten net sells by investment trusts were headed by Winbond Electronics with 1,987 shares, followed by Fubon Financial (1,687 shares), Yageo (1,518 shares), ASE Technology Holding, Nanya Technology, Advantech, Qisda, Yulon, Everlight, and Chih Mao.

Institutional analysts said that, from a technical perspective, the daily chart closed in the red and fell below the 5‑day moving average, indicating a short‑term pull‑back. With the close near the day's low, upward momentum appears limited, though the index remains above the 10‑day line. They cautioned against labeling a medium‑term bearish shift based on a single day’s decline. They recommend watching whether today’s low can hold; resistance is around the 48,000‑point mark. If a pull‑back occurs with shrinking volume and the low stabilizes while heavyweight electronics stocks stop falling, the market could consolidate and later resume a rally.

items.title: 美債殖利率飆升 股市感受壓力前企業信用市場恐先出現裂痕
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Stock Market Feels Pressure, Corporate Credit Market May Show Cracks First
paras: 華爾街原本希望上周的債市暴跌已經是最糟糕的情況，但周一(28日)的市場表現顯示情況可能並非如此，美國公債殖利率續升至多年高點。這不只打壓股市，也影響美國消費者與企業在房貸、汽車貸款及信用卡債務等各種借貸上的成本。
10年期美債殖利率周一周一盤中一度升至5.27%，收盤報5.241%，創2007年6月以來新高，30年期殖利率也上升6個基點至5.561%，創24年新高。兩者均已連續五個交易日走升。
經歷艱難的上周後，美國債市周一並未擺脫「不妙的9月」，公債市場可能創下多年來最差的單月表現：9月以來，10年期殖利率已上升近48個基點，30年期殖利率則上升31個基點。

油價與升息預期 雙重力量推升殖利率

美債殖利率最新一波升勢，主因是周末有報導指出川普拒絕伊朗提出的停火方案，並預料在美國11月期中選舉後再次轟炸伊朗，這使油價應聲上漲，進一步鞏固通膨升溫和升息預期。
能源價格上漲，促使長天期債券持有人要求更高殖利率，以補償額外的不確定性，在此同時，市場預期聯準會(Fed)將進一步升息，也對短天期債券構成壓力。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，聯準基金期貨交易員目前押注Fed 10月再升息1碼(25個基點)的機率接近75%，12月再升息的機率則為60%。
近期殖利率上升是多重因素共同發揮作用的結果，除了油價、通膨和升息預期以外，美國政府和人工智慧(AI)企業大量發債也是助長力量。此外，由於AI建設讓美國經濟強勁成長，投資人對債券的需求有所下滑。

小型股與殖利率敏感類股首當其衝

近期殖利率上升對小型股打擊尤其嚴重，其他對殖利率特別敏感的股市領域，如公用事業及營建商，也受到衝擊。即使是被視為不確定性時期經典避險資產的黃金，在近期大漲後也開始走弱。
投資人已注意到，債市波動率不斷升高，但股市相對平靜，兩者之間出現明顯背離。
Clark Capital Management Group固定收益主管Oliver Chambers接受MarketWatch電話訪問時表示：「我們應該開始看到股市對此做出反應。每當殖利率跳升50個基點，就應該開始對股市形成壓力。目前兩者的反應並不完全一致。」

企業信用市場恐先感受到壓力

然而，在股市真正感受到壓力之前，企業信用市場的債券可能已因大量發債而面臨壓力。
根據Glenmede彙整的數據，2026年美國公債與企業債券發行量預估將達到接近8兆美元的紀錄高點。AI超大規模資料中心業者(hyperscalers)今年來已發行約2470億美元債務，是2024年的12倍以上。
Glenmede投資策略與研究主管Jason Pride及投資策略副總裁Michael Reynolds說：「隨著政府與企業尋求融資，市場正在吸收前所未有的發債量，加劇對稀缺資本的競爭。」
Glenmede策略師團隊指出，儘管融資需求大幅增加，可用於滿足這些需求的儲蓄資金池成長速度卻慢得多，因此金融資產供給成長速度已超過可供吸收這些資產的資本。因此投資人可能要求更高的報酬，以換取資金。
他們補充指出：「這種更高的必要報酬，可能轉化為更低的資產價格，以及更高的未來預期報酬。」
paras_en: Wall Street had hoped that last week's bond market plunge was the worst it would see, but Monday's (the 28th) market performance suggests the situation may be even worse, as U.S. Treasury yields continued to climb to multi‑year highs. This not only drags down equities but also raises the cost of borrowing for U.S. consumers and businesses on mortgages, auto loans and credit‑card debt.

The 10‑year Treasury yield spiked to 5.27% intraday on Monday and closed at 5.241%, a peak not seen since June 2007, while the 30‑year yield rose six basis points to 5.561%, a 24‑year high. Both have risen for five consecutive trading days.

After a tough week, the U.S. bond market on Monday did not shake off a "troubled September," and the Treasury market may be posting its worst monthly performance in years: since September, the 10‑year yield has climbed nearly 48 basis points and the 30‑year yield up 31 basis points.

Higher oil prices and rate‑hike expectations are the twin forces pushing yields higher. The latest rally in Treasury yields was sparked by weekend reports that former President Trump rejected Iran's cease‑fire proposal and is expected to resume bombing Iran after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November, sending oil prices soaring and reinforcing inflation‑rise and rate‑hike expectations.

Rising energy prices are prompting long‑duration bond holders to demand higher yields to compensate for added uncertainty, while market expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep raising rates are also putting pressure on short‑duration bonds.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, futures traders are currently betting that the Fed will raise rates by another 25‑basis‑point “step” in October with a probability close to 75%, and that a December hike has about a 60% chance.

The recent yield rise is the result of multiple factors working together; beyond oil, inflation and rate‑hike expectations, massive issuance by the U.S. government and AI companies is also fueling the move. Moreover, AI‑driven economic strength is dampening investors’ demand for bonds.

Small‑cap stocks and yield‑sensitive sectors are hit first. The recent yield climb has been especially painful for small‑cap stocks, and other yield‑sensitive areas such as utilities and builders have also felt the impact. Even gold, the classic safe‑haven in uncertain times, has begun to weaken after a recent rally.
Investors have noted that bond‑market volatility is rising steadily while the equity market remains relatively calm, creating a clear divergence between the two.

Oliver Chambers, head of fixed income at Clark Capital Management Group, told MarketWatch by phone: "We should start seeing the equity market react. Every time yields jump 50 basis points, pressure on stocks should begin to build. So far the reactions haven’t been fully aligned,"
Corporate credit markets may feel the pressure first, even before the equity market does, as a flood of new issuance could strain them.

Glenmede’s compiled data projects that U.S. Treasury and corporate bond issuance in 2026 will approach a record $8 trillion. AI hyperscalers have issued about $247 billion of debt this year, more than 12 times the amount issued in 2024.

Jason Pride, head of investment strategy and research at Glenmede, and investment strategy VP Michael Reynolds said, "As governments and corporations seek financing, the market is absorbing an unprecedented volume of issuance, intensifying competition for scarce capital."

Glenmede strategists note that although financing demand has surged, the pool of savings available to meet that demand is growing far more slowly, so the supply of financial assets now outpaces the capital able to absorb them, prompting investors to demand higher returns for providing funds.
They added, "This higher required return could translate into lower asset prices and higher expected future returns."

items.title: 特納斯上任就動刀！蘋果擬打破春秋兩季發表新品慣例
items.title_en: Ternus Moves Quickly After Taking the Helm! Apple Plans to Break Its Spring and Fall Product Launch Tradition
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)上任數周後，已著手研議調整產品開發與組織架構，希望加快新品推出速度、擴大裝置陣容，並精簡管理層級。這些構想顯示，曾掌管硬體工程的特納斯，正試圖改變蘋果在庫克(Tim Cook)領導15年間建立的運作方式。
外媒周二(29日)引述知情人士報導，特納斯已在內部討論減少依賴春、秋兩季發表新品的慣例，改為全年更頻繁地推出產品。他認為，在人工智慧(AI)時代，蘋果必須加快開發並勇於嘗試新產品。不過，員工指出，改變行之多年的開發流程並不容易，可能需要數年才能完成。

加快新品節奏 精簡管理層級

蘋果明年規畫推出多款新裝置，包括配備相機的AirPods、首款智慧眼鏡，以及紀念iPhone問世20周年的重新設計機型。更密集的產品時程，也讓開發團隊面臨壓力。知情人士形容，主管如今更直接參與開發工作，團隊被要求在更短時間內推出更多產品。
在人事方面，蘋果硬體工程部門過去兩周已通知部分工程專案經理離職，受影響者包括約六名總監級員工。這些專案經理長期負責掌握開發時程、協調跨團隊工作。受影響員工只有數周時間尋找公司內部其他職位，未能轉任者將於今年稍晚遭到裁員。蘋果近月也縮減Siri、Vision Pro及部分AI軟體團隊，並提早收掉對營收貢獻較低的開發計畫。
特納斯也在探索如何以AI加快產品開發、處理部分員工工作。蘋果今年夏天曾研議裁撤約5,000名AppleCare客服人員，評估讓AI客服接手部分業務，但最終暫停該計畫，目前沒有執行打算。

服務成長放緩 尋找新收入

精簡組織之外，特納斯也與服務業務主管克佑(Eddy Cue)、財務長帕雷克(Kevan Parekh)討論推出新服務，並提高現有產品的收入。蘋果服務業務仍較去年同期成長，但今年第二季營收較前一季下滑，為2022年以來首見季減；App Store的營運模式也承受壓力。
零組件成本同樣增加。全球記憶體供應吃緊推高蘋果的採購支出，儘管公司已調漲部分產品價格，仍須自行吸收部分成本，以免漲價幅度嚇退顧客。對特納斯而言，更頻繁地推出新品，既能帶動裝置銷售，也可能為新服務吸引使用者，但組織調整與成本控管仍將持續。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) new CEO John Ternus, just weeks into his tenure, has already begun discussing adjustments to product development and organizational structure, aiming to speed up new product releases, expand the device lineup, and streamline management layers. These ideas show that Ternus, who previously oversaw hardware engineering, is trying to change the operating model Apple has built over Tim Cook’s 15‑year leadership.

Foreign media on Tuesday (the 29th) quoted insiders saying Ternus is discussing internally reducing reliance on the traditional spring and fall product launches, shifting to more frequent releases throughout the year. He believes that in the AI era Apple must accelerate development and be bold in trying new products. However, employees note that altering a decades‑long development process won’t be easy and could take several years to complete.

Accelerating the product cadence and flattening management layers Apple plans to roll out multiple new devices next year, including camera‑equipped AirPods, its first smart glasses, and a redesigned model to mark the iPhone’s 20th anniversary. The tighter schedule puts pressure on development teams. Insiders say managers are now more directly involved in the work, and teams are being asked to deliver more products in shorter timeframes.

On the personnel side, Apple’s hardware engineering division has notified several project managers of termination over the past two weeks, affecting about six director‑level employees. These managers have long been responsible for tracking development timelines and coordinating cross‑team work. Affected staff have only a few weeks to find other internal roles; those who cannot be reassigned will be laid off later this year. Apple has also recently trimmed Siri, Vision Pro, and parts of its AI software teams, and has prematurely shut down lower‑revenue development projects.

Ternus is also exploring how AI can speed up product development and handle some employee tasks. This summer Apple considered cutting roughly 5,000 AppleCare support staff and evaluating AI‑driven customer service, but the plan was paused and there are currently no implementation plans.

Beyond organizational slimming, Ternus has been discussing new services and ways to boost revenue from existing products with services chief Eddy Cue and CFO Kevin Parekh. Apple’s services business still grew year‑over‑year, but second‑quarter revenue fell versus the prior quarter—the first quarterly decline since 2022—and the App Store’s operating model is under pressure.

Component costs are also rising. Global memory shortages have pushed Apple’s procurement expenses higher; even though the company has raised prices on some products, it still absorbs part of the cost to avoid scaring customers with steep price hikes. For Ternus, more frequent product launches can drive device sales and attract users to new services, but organizational adjustments and cost control will remain ongoing challenges.

items.title: 油價漲、Fed恐再升息！美債遭拋售 30年期公債殖利率創24年新高
items.title_en: Oil Prices Rise, Fed May Hike Again! US Bonds Sold Off as 30-Year Treasury Yield Hits 24-Year High
paras: 美國公債賣壓持續升溫，30年期公債殖利率周二(29日)連續第六個交易日攀升，一度觸及5.613%，創2002年以來最高。中東戰事推高能源價格，市場憂心通膨再起、聯準會(Fed)繼續升息；企業債發行增加及美國財政疑慮，也加重債市壓力。
截稿前，30年期公債殖利率盤中報5.609%，較前一交易日上升約4個基點。10年期公債殖利率升至約5.285%，處於2007年以來高檔；2年期殖利率約4.922%。公債價格與殖利率走勢相反。
美伊戰爭已持續約七個月，油價居高不下，使投資人擔心物價壓力延續。本月Fed以12比0全員一致升息1碼後，交易員目前押注10月會議再次升息的機率超過72%。美國經濟活動強勁及政府債務規模，也讓公債殖利率進一步走高。
這波跌勢不只衝擊長天期公債。根據《彭博》指數，美國公債今年迄今下跌2.6%，相較去年上漲6.3%。花旗策略師形容，債市正經歷「輕度買方罷工」；知名美國獨立金融市場與總體經濟研究機構雅迪尼研究(Yardeni Research)則認為，以日元融資投資高收益資產的套利交易平倉，也助長全球債券拋售。
季節因素可能使賣壓延續。過去十年，美國公債9月跌幅中位數為0.9%，10月為0.7%。道明證券策略師Prashant Newnaha警告，若中東局勢遲遲無法化解，固定收益市場可能持續降低風險部位，賣壓甚至蔓延至股市。道富投資管理公司策略師Masahiko Loo指出，秋季公債供給回升，加上企業發債與AI資本支出需求，將使資金競爭更加激烈。
不過，也有投資人認為債市已跌過頭。華爾街資深人士Jim Bianco六年來首次看好美國公債，RBC BlueBay投資長Mark Dowding則認為，全球債券遭到過度拋售。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury selling pressure continued to heat up, with the 30-year Treasury yield climbing for the sixth consecutive trading day on Tuesday (the 29th), briefly reaching 5.613% – the highest level since 2002. The Middle East conflict has pushed energy prices higher, sparking market worries about a resurgence of inflation and further Fed rate hikes; increased corporate bond issuance and concerns over U.S. fiscal health have also added pressure to the bond market.

At the time of writing, the 30-year Treasury yield was trading at 5.609% intraday, about four basis points higher than the previous session. The 10-year yield rose to roughly 5.285%, a peak not seen since 2007, while the 2-year yield was about 4.922%. Treasury prices move inversely to yields.

The U.S.-Iran war has now lasted about seven months, and persistently high oil prices are making investors worry that price pressures will continue. After the Fed unanimously raised rates by one quarter-point this month (12‑0 vote), traders are now betting that the October meeting will see another hike with a probability exceeding 72%. Strong U.S. economic activity and the size of government debt are also pushing Treasury yields higher.

The sell‑off is not limited to long‑dated bonds. According to Bloomberg data, U.S. Treasuries are down 2.6% year‑to‑date, compared with a 6.3% gain last year. Citi strategists described the bond market as undergoing a “mild buyer strike,” while the independent research firm Yardeni Research said that the unwinding of yen‑funded arbitrage trades into high‑yield assets is further fueling the global bond sell‑off.

Seasonal factors may keep the pressure on. Over the past decade, the median September decline for U.S. Treasuries has been 0.9% and the median October decline 0.7%. TD Securities strategist Prashant Newnaha warned that if the Middle East situation remains unresolved, the fixed‑income market could keep trimming risk positions, with selling pressure potentially spilling over into equities. State Street Global Advisors strategist Masahiko Loo noted that autumn Treasury supply is picking up, and combined with corporate issuance and AI‑driven capital spending, competition for funding will intensify.

Nevertheless, some investors think the bond market has oversold. Wall Street veteran Jim Bianco is bullish on U.S. Treasuries for the first time in six years, and RBC BlueBay’s chief investment officer Mark Dowding believes global bonds have been sold off excessively.

items.title: 美國8月職缺降至5個月低點！低裁員撐住就業 Fed仍有升息空間
items.title_en: U.S. August Job Openings Drop to Five-Month Low; Low Layoffs Support Employment, Fed Still Has Rate‑Hike Room
paras: 美國8月職缺降至五個月低點，連續第三個月不如市場預期，但裁員人數也降至2025年3月以來最低，招聘則小幅回升，顯示勞動市場仍處於「低招聘、低裁員」格局。企業擴編意願雖偏弱，卻未出現大規模裁員，讓聯準會(Fed)仍有空間優先對抗通膨。
美國勞工統計局周二(29日)公布職缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)，8月職缺減少25.6萬個至707.9萬個，低於市場預估的約722萬個。7月數據由727.1萬個上修至733.5萬個，8月職缺率則從4.4%降至4.3%。

職缺縮減遍及多個產業 求職與轉職機會收窄

職缺減少涵蓋專業與商業服務、醫療與社會援助、州與地方政府，以及製造業和營建業；貿易、資訊、休閒與餐旅業則增加。其中，房地產與租賃業職缺銳減近半至5萬個，創2014年2月以來最低，顯示部分產業用人需求明顯轉弱。
每名失業者對應的職缺數，也由7月約1.1個降至約1個，遠低於2022年高峰的2個。這項Fed密切追蹤的指標，反映勞動供需大致平衡，但也意味求職者不再擁有過去那麼多選擇。
8月主動離職人數減少2.3萬人至306.6萬人，離職率維持1.9%，追平2020年以來最低，反映勞工對找到更好工作的信心不足。企業招聘意願偏低，使在職者不敢輕易跳槽，待業者也更難進入市場。同日公布的9月消費者信心降至2014年以來最低，民眾對就業前景也更悲觀。

低裁員支撐就業穩定 Fed仍有升息空間

不過，求職難度增加，尚未演變成裁員潮。8月招聘增加4.6萬人至519.2萬人，招聘率由3.2%升至3.3%；裁員與解僱減少6.1萬人至164.1萬人，相關比率從1.1%降至1%。初領失業救濟金人數也維持歷史低檔附近，顯示企業仍傾向留住現有人力。
經濟學家認為，美伊戰爭帶來的不確定性，是企業不願擴大招聘的原因之一。能源價格攀升推高通膨，柴油價格更創歷史新高，恐進一步拖累經濟。這使Fed面臨兩面考驗：招聘疲弱值得留意，但低裁員與穩定的失業率，仍讓官員有餘裕處理物價壓力。
Fed本月升息1碼，將基準利率調至3.75%至4%，為三年來首次升息，並暗示後續可能續升。根據芝商所FedWatch工具數據，市場押注10月再升息的機率約70.3%。
周五(10/2)公布的9月非農就業報告，將進一步檢驗勞動市場韌性。市場預估新增就業9萬人，低於8月的16.2萬人，失業率則維持4.1%。若招聘放緩卻未推升失業率，Fed仍有理由聚焦通膨；若就業明顯惡化，後續升息的取捨就會更複雜。不過，JOLTS回覆率較疫情前明顯下降，且與非農統計口徑不同，仍須搭配其他數據判讀，不能僅憑職缺減少就斷言就業將失速。
paras_en: U.S. August job openings fell to a five‑month low, marking the third consecutive month they missed market expectations, while layoffs also fell to their lowest level since March 2025 and hiring rebounded slightly, indicating the labor market remains in a "low hiring, low layoffs" pattern. Although firms' willingness to expand is weak, there has been no wave of large‑scale layoffs, leaving the Federal Reserve room to prioritize fighting inflation.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on Tuesday (the 29th). August job openings declined by 256,000 to 7.079 million, below the market forecast of roughly 7.22 million. July’s figure was revised up from 7.271 million to 7.335 million, and the August job‑opening rate fell from 4.4% to 4.3%.

Job cuts were seen across many sectors, narrowing job‑search and career‑change opportunities. Openings fell in professional and business services, health care and social assistance, state and local government, as well as manufacturing and construction, while trade, information, leisure and hospitality added jobs. Notably, real‑estate and rental openings plunged almost half to 50,000, the lowest since February 2014, showing a clear weakening in demand for workers in some industries.

The number of job openings per unemployed worker dropped from about 1.1 in July to roughly 1 in August, far below the 2022 peak of 2. This Fed‑watched indicator suggests labor supply and demand are roughly balanced, but also means job seekers no longer have as many choices as before.

August voluntary quits fell by 23,000 to 3.066 million, keeping the quit rate at 1.9%—a low tied with the post‑2020 minimum—reflecting workers’ lack of confidence in finding better jobs. Weak hiring appetite makes employed workers reluctant to switch jobs and makes the unemployed find it harder to enter the market. On the same day, September consumer confidence slid to its lowest since 2014, deepening pessimism about employment prospects.

Low layoffs are supporting employment stability, and the Fed still has room to raise rates. Yet job‑search difficulty has risen, though it has not turned into a layoff wave. August hires rose by 46,000 to 5.192 million, lifting the hiring rate from 3.2% to 3.3%; layoffs and discharges fell by 61,000 to 1.641 million, dropping the related rate from 1.1% to 1%. Initial unemployment benefit claims also stayed near historic lows, showing firms still prefer to retain existing staff.

Economists say the uncertainty from the U.S.–Iran conflict is one reason firms are reluctant to expand hiring. Rising energy prices are pushing inflation higher, with diesel hitting record highs and threatening further economic drag. This puts the Fed in a two‑sided dilemma: weak hiring warrants attention, but low layoffs and a stable unemployment rate give officials leeway to address price pressures.

The Fed raised its policy rate by one quarter‑point this month, moving the target range to 3.75%–4.00%, the first hike in three years, and signaled that further increases are possible. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market assigns roughly a 70.3% probability to another hike in October.

The September non‑farm payroll report, due Friday (Oct 2), will further test labor‑market resilience. Analysts expect 90,000 new jobs, down from August’s 162,000, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.1%. If hiring slows without pushing the unemployment rate up, the Fed can keep its focus on inflation; if employment deteriorates sharply, the calculus for further hikes becomes more complex. However, JOLTS response rates have fallen noticeably since the pandemic and its coverage differs from the payroll survey, so the data must be read alongside other indicators and not be used alone to claim that employment is about to stall.

items.title: 黃金、高收益債一起倒！交易員更看好誰反彈？
items.title_en: Gold and High‑Yield Bonds Both Crash! Which Do Traders Expect to Rebound?
paras: 美國公債殖利率持續攀升，重挫黃金與高收益公司債兩大資產，但選擇權交易透露不同押注：交易員看好黃金有望反彈，對高收益債則偏向悲觀。
美國10年期公債殖利率升至5.3%、30年期觸及5.4%，黃金下跌4%，跌至8月首周以來最低。追蹤高收益公司債的iShares iBoxx高收益公司債ETF(HYG-US)則連跌五日，降至2025年4月以來低點。
Cboe Global Markets(CBOE-US)旗下LiveVol數據顯示，周一(28日)SPDR黃金ETF(GLD-US)買權成交量約為賣權兩倍，其中推估主動買進的買權逾6.8萬口，賣權不到3.2萬口。Barchart分析顯示，淨交易情緒偏多近280萬美元，Delta方向性曝險淨額約10.5萬，同樣偏向多方。
不過，GLD買權的買進與賣出數量相近。當天最大單筆交易是賣出2,000口2028年1月到期、履約價375美元的賣權，交易金額590萬美元，可能是平倉既有空頭部位，也可能押注GLD在375美元附近築底。GLD今夏多數時間在370至380美元間震盪，賣出賣權的投資人可收取權利金，但須承擔價格下跌的風險。
兩檔ETF均與10年期公債殖利率呈高度負相關，GLD的10日相關係數為負0.8，HYG則為負0.99，但HYG選擇權交易更明顯偏空。
HYG周一選擇權成交量超過30日均量的2.5倍，賣權成交量也超過買權的2.5倍。推估主動買進的賣權約5.2萬口，買權僅逾1.5萬口。
SpotGamma數據顯示，HYG選擇權權利金交易總額約3,500萬美元，其中3,000萬美元涉及買權。不過，依買進金額排名，前12大契約有11個是賣權；按成交量排名，前10大契約有8個是賣權。最熱門的買進契約為11月20日到期、履約價78美元的賣權。
The Arora Report創辦人Nigam Arora警告，高收益債市場過度安逸，違約風險可能遠高於市場預期。他指出，許多相關債務採浮動利率，明年又將面臨到期壓力。投資人雖追求收益，但信用利差提供的補償不足，風險報酬並不吸引人，直言自己不會碰這類資產。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields kept climbing, crushing both gold and high‑yield corporate bonds, yet options trading revealed divergent bets: traders are more optimistic that gold could bounce back, while they remain pessimistic on high‑yield debt.

The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose to 5.3% and the 30‑year hit 5.4%, sending gold down 4% to its lowest level since the first week of August. The iShares iBoxx High‑Yield Corporate Bond ETF (HYG‑US), which tracks high‑yield bonds, fell for a fifth straight day, sliding to its lowest point since April 2025.

Cboe Global Markets’ LiveVol data showed that on Monday the 28th, the SPDR Gold ETF (GLD‑US) call volume was about twice the put volume, with an estimated 68,000 actively bought calls versus fewer than 32,000 puts. Barchart analysis indicated a net long sentiment of roughly $2.8 million and a net directional delta exposure of about 105,000, also skewed bullish.

However, the number of GLD calls bought and sold was close. The day’s largest single trade was the sale of 2,000 put contracts expiring in January 2028 with a $375 strike, worth $5.9 million, possibly closing existing short positions or betting that GLD would find a floor around $375. GLD has mostly traded between $370 and $380 this summer; investors who sell puts collect premium but bear the risk of a price drop.
Both ETFs are highly negatively correlated with the 10‑year Treasury yield—GLD’s 10‑day correlation coefficient is –0.8 and HYG’s is –0.99—but HYG options show a clearer bearish tilt.

HYG’s option volume on Monday was more than 2.5 times its 30‑day average, with put volume also exceeding call volume by over 2.5‑to‑1. Roughly 52,000 puts were actively bought versus just over 15,000 calls.

SpotGamma data indicated total premium traded on HYG options was about $35 million, of which $30 million involved calls. Yet, by dollar amount of purchases, 11 of the top 12 contracts were puts; by volume, 8 of the top 10 contracts were puts. The most popular purchased contract was a put expiring on November 20 with a $78 strike.

Nigam Arora, founder of The Arora Report, warned that the high‑yield bond market is overly complacent and default risk could be far higher than markets expect. He noted many of the debts are floating‑rate and will face rollover pressure next year. While investors chase yield, the credit spread compensation is insufficient, making the risk‑reward unattractive, and he stated he would stay away from such assets.

paras_en: Morgan Stanley says the hype around AI “shovel‑seller” trades remains strong. In a client report dated September 24, the bank noted that while it is still a good time to start positioning in AI‑adoption companies and software stocks to catch the next AI wave, investors should also keep an eye on stocks tied to the data‑center energy bottleneck.
According to Business Insider, Morgan Stanley analysts wrote in the report that demand for compute power could far outstrip supply over the next few years.
The firm believes data‑center construction is constrained by several factors, including limited power supply, a tight labor market for building data centers, and regulatory hurdles.
Historically, in technology cycles, when market focus shifts to companies that benefit from tech adoption, infrastructure‑related deals tend to lag behind.
However, the bank says that this round of data‑center building is being hampered by supply limits while demand stays robust, which will continue to drive such deals.

Morgan Stanley stated: “We expect market leadership will not shift along a single path as it has in past compute cycles. Instead, over the next six to twelve months we anticipate AI‑adoption firms and AI ‘shovel‑seller’ stocks to show a ‘barbell‑type’ relative strength.”

Under the AI power‑bottleneck theme, Morgan Stanley listed stocks that analysts have upgraded to “add.” The following twelve US equities are highlighted, each with a target price that implies at least a 40% upside from current levels.

items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Open Higher as Oil Prices and Treasury Yields Cool; S&P 500 and Nasdaq Gain

標普500指數前一交易日回吐9月全部漲幅後，期貨上漲0.1%。美國10年期公債殖利率下滑2個基點，略低於19年高點，美元持平。隨著主要產油國沙國恢復一條關鍵管線輸油，布蘭特原油跌破每桶104美元。
本周初油價劇烈波動引發股債賣壓後，市場逐漸回穩。投資人正關注美國總統川普與產業領袖討論AI安全風險的午餐會，尋找下一波行情催化因素。
密集經濟數據也將由8月職缺報告揭開序幕，另有六名聯準會(Federal Reserve，Fed)官員發表談話。目前市場預期未來12個月最多升息四次，官員發言將提供利率走向線索。
紐約梅隆銀行(BK-US)資深總體策略師Geoff Yu表示，市場近日波動劇烈，周五非農就業報告又是關鍵催化因素，投資人此時調整部位合乎情理；月底也會出現與數據無關的被動交易。
儘管借貸成本攀升威脅經濟成長及企業獲利，股市近幾周仍具韌性。不過，估值與龐大資本支出能否帶來合理回報的疑慮，讓晶片及AI相關股能否續漲面臨考驗。
AI潛在危害也成為焦點，Anthropic執行長阿莫戴等業界人士呼籲放慢開發腳步。除與川普會談外，市場也關注OpenAI執行長阿特曼在年度開發者大會的說法。OpenAI正暫緩推出一個版本的Astra模型，以增設更嚴密的安全防護。
通膨壓力方面，澳洲央行周二將利率升至約15年高點；西班牙通膨進一步高於歐洲央行2%目標，強化歐元區升息理由。
英國公債表現優於歐洲同業，市場等待首相柏南(Andy Burnham)在利物浦工黨大會演說。官員預期，他可能提議討論改革國家退休金制度，以支應社會照護。
