paras_en: U.S. equities opened higher on Tuesday (the 29th), with oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields retreating, easing market pressure and lifting both the S&P 500 and the Nasdaq. Media reports disclosed details of Anthropic’s initial public offering, further boosting tech‑stock buying. However, investors remain cautious ahead of this week’s first batch of employment data and a series of AI events.

At the close of trading, the Dow Jones Industrial Average was down about 70 points, or roughly 0.1%, the Nasdaq Composite rose about 20 points, also about 0.1%, the S&P 500 slipped about 0.02%, the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gained about 1.4%, and TSMC ADR fell about 1.0%.

The pullback in oil prices nudged U.S. stock futures slightly higher and Treasury yields lower, while traders stayed on the sidelines ahead of the week’s first employment reports and several AI‑related events.

After giving back all of September’s gains in the previous session, the S&P 500 futures rose 0.1%. The 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield fell two basis points, staying just below its 2019 peak, and the dollar was flat. With Saudi Arabia restoring a key oil pipeline, Brent crude slipped below $104 a barrel.

Following volatile oil price swings early in the week that sparked a sell‑off in stocks and bonds, the market has gradually steadied. Investors are watching a lunchtime meeting between President Trump and industry leaders on AI safety risks, looking for the next market catalyst.

A string of economic data will start with the August JOLTS job‑vacancy report, and six Federal Reserve officials are slated to speak. The market currently expects at most four rate hikes over the next 12 months, and the officials’ remarks should give clues on the rate path.

Geoff Yu, senior macro strategist at BNY Mellon, said the market has been very volatile lately and that Friday’s non‑farm payroll report will be a key catalyst, so it makes sense for investors to adjust positions now; he also expects some passive trading at month‑end unrelated to the data.

Even though rising borrowing costs threaten growth and corporate earnings, equities have shown resilience in recent weeks. Yet doubts about whether valuations and massive cap‑ex spending can deliver reasonable returns put the continued rally in chip and AI‑related stocks to the test.

The potential hazards of AI have also become a focus, with Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and other industry figures urging a slower development pace. In addition to the Trump meeting, the market is watching OpenAI CEO Sam Altman’s remarks at the annual developer conference. OpenAI is pausing the rollout of a version of its Astra model to add tighter safety safeguards.

On inflation, the Reserve Bank of Australia raised rates on Tuesday to a roughly 15‑year high, while Spain’s inflation rose further above the European Central Bank’s 2% target, strengthening the case for rate hikes across the euro area.

U.K. gilts are outperforming their European peers, and the market is awaiting Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s speech at the Labour Party conference in Liverpool. Officials expect he may propose reforms to the national pension system to fund social care.

Bloomberg strategist Skylar Montgomery Koning noted that oil‑supply shocks persist and a risk premium remains warranted, but the outlook for crude is biased lower, and options markets are sending a similar signal. If oil prices stay subdued, even with elevated Treasury yields, risk‑asset pressure could ease.

items.title: 輝達獲利狂奔、估值卻掉隊！14.5倍本益比背後 華爾街在擔心什麼？
items.title_en: Nvidia's Profit Surge Leaves Valuation Lagging: What Wall Street Fears Behind a 14.5‑Times P/E?
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)日前宣布加碼1,500億美元股票回購授權，創公司紀錄之際，其股票按一項關鍵估值指標衡量，已處於近十年最便宜水準。執行長黃仁勳認為，這正是買回自家股票的大好機會。
據《CNBC》周二(29日)報導，輝達將於明年2月展開的2028會計年度，預估本益比僅14.5倍，在大型同業中僅高於美光(MU-US)。其過去五年當期本益比平均為62.9倍，是目前水準的兩倍以上。
輝達市值已超過5.5兆美元，穩居全球市值最高企業，今年股價上漲23%、表現優於那斯達克指數，卻仍追不上預期獲利成長速度。分析師平均預估，2028會計年度淨利將接近3,850億美元，年增60%，並達三年前的五倍以上。

加碼回購回饋股東 黃仁勳喊兼具成長與價值

這次新增授權是在5月宣布的800億美元回購計畫之外加碼；輝達當時也將每季現金股利由每股0.01美元提高至0.25美元。公司周一另推出管理AI代理的新軟硬體方案，當天股價上漲近2%。
Post Oak Group董事總經理Karan Ramchandani表示，回購清楚傳達管理層認為股價遭低估，獲利成長快於股價，也讓買回股票成為公司眼中未來一年最好的投資。
隨著建置與運行AI模型所需的繪圖處理器(GPU)需求推升營收及現金流，輝達8月預估，2028會計年度營收將成長70%，意味營收將比華爾街先前預測高出數千億美元。
黃仁勳本月在高盛(GS-US)會議上表示，市場「誤解」輝達，稱公司是全球首家、也是唯一兼具成長與價值的股票。他上月便稱回購輝達股票是「絕佳機會」，周一再表示，未來將創造大量現金，希望回饋股東。
輝達先前表示，計劃將約半數自由現金流回饋投資人。若全數執行現有回購授權，流通股數可望減少4%。

估值低於主要對手 市場擔憂高成長難延續

Deepwater Asset Management管理合夥人Gene Munster指出，投資人擔心，歷經數年爆發式成長後，輝達成長率將放緩，這正是估值受到壓抑的原因。
以相近期間衡量，蘋果(AAPL-US)、Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、微軟(MSFT-US)及亞馬遜(AMZN-US)預估本益比分別為35.5、22.6、21.7及23.2倍，均高於輝達。AI資料中心晶片對手博通(AVGO-US)、超微(AMD-US)及英特爾(INTC-US)則分別為18.2、38.2及54.7倍，且沒有一家預估明年營收成長70%。
博通替OpenAI與Alphabet旗下Google開發客製晶片；超微雖在GPU市場與輝達競爭，市占仍遠落其後；英特爾以中央處理器為主，也曾涉足AI晶片，但尚無足以抗衡輝達GPU的產品。
Melius Research分析師Ben Reitzes維持買進評等，認為輝達的成長率值得更高估值，擴大回購將有助改善。瑞銀(UBS-US)則估計，加碼回購可使2027曆年每股盈餘增加0.08美元，其對該年度每股盈餘預估為17.16美元。
paras_en: Nvidia (NVDA-US) recently announced an additional $150 billion stock‑repurchase authorization, setting a company record, yet its shares are measured by a key valuation metric as being at the cheapest level in nearly a decade. CEO Jensen Huang says this is a prime opportunity to buy back the company’s own stock.

According to CNBC on Tuesday (the 29th), Nvidia’s projected price‑to‑earnings ratio for fiscal 2028, which begins in February next year, is only 14.5 times, second‑only to Micron (MU‑US) among large peers. Its average forward P/E over the past five years has been 62.9 times, more than double the current level.

Nvidia’s market value has topped $5.5 trillion, keeping it the world’s most valuable company. Its stock is up 23% this year, outperforming the Nasdaq index, but it still can’t keep pace with expected profit growth. Analysts on average forecast fiscal 2028 net income of about $385 billion, a 60% year‑over‑year increase and more than five times the amount three years ago.

Increasing the buyback to reward shareholders, Huang says the move combines growth and value. This new authorization builds on the $80 billion buyback plan announced in May, when Nvidia also raised its quarterly cash dividend from $0.01 to $0.25 per share. The company also launched a new AI‑agent hardware‑software solution on Monday, sending the stock up nearly 2%.

Post Oak Group Managing Director Karan Ramchandani said the repurchase clearly signals that management believes the stock is undervalued and earnings are growing faster than the price, making the buyback the best investment for the company over the next year.

With demand for graphics processing units (GPUs) needed to build and run AI models driving revenue and cash flow, Nvidia projected in August that fiscal 2028 revenue will grow 70%, meaning revenue will be several hundred billion dollars higher than Wall Street’s earlier forecasts.

Huang told a Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) conference this month that the market “misunderstands” Nvidia, calling the company the world’s first and only stock that offers both growth and value. He called the share repurchase an “excellent opportunity” last month and reiterated on Monday that the company will generate massive cash and wants to return it to shareholders.

Nvidia previously said it plans to return roughly half of its free cash flow to investors. If it fully executes the existing repurchase authorizations, the number of shares outstanding could fall by about 4%.

Valuation below major rivals, market worries about sustaining high growth. Deepwater Asset Management partner Gene Munster noted investors fear that after years of explosive growth, Nvidia’s growth rate will slow, which is why its valuation is under pressure.

Over comparable periods, Apple (AAPL‑US), Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Microsoft (MSFT‑US) and Amazon (AMZN‑US) have projected P/E ratios of 35.5, 22.6, 21.7 and 23.2 respectively, all higher than Nvidia’s. AI data‑center chip rivals Broadcom (AVGO‑US), AMD (AMD‑US) and Intel (INTC‑US) trade at 18.2, 38.2 and 54.7 times, and none are expected to post 70% revenue growth next year.

Broadcom builds custom chips for OpenAI and Google’s Alphabet; AMD competes with Nvidia in the GPU market but its share remains far behind; Intel focuses on CPUs, has dabbled in AI chips but lacks a product that can challenge Nvidia’s GPUs.

Melius Research analyst Ben Reitzes maintains a buy rating, arguing Nvidia’s growth rate merits a higher valuation and that an expanded buyback will help. UBS estimates that the additional repurchase could lift fiscal 2027 earnings per share by $0.08, to an estimated $17.16 per share.

items.title: 美債殖利率飆升 股市感受壓力前企業信用市場恐先出現裂痕
items.title_en: U.S. Treasury Yields Surge, Stock Market Feels Pressure, Corporate Credit Market May Show Cracks First
paras: 華爾街原本希望上周的債市暴跌已經是最糟糕的情況，但周一(28日)的市場表現顯示情況可能並非如此，美國公債殖利率續升至多年高點。這不只打壓股市，也影響美國消費者與企業在房貸、汽車貸款及信用卡債務等各種借貸上的成本。
10年期美債殖利率周一周一盤中一度升至5.27%，收盤報5.241%，創2007年6月以來新高，30年期殖利率也上升6個基點至5.561%，創24年新高。兩者均已連續五個交易日走升。
經歷艱難的上周後，美國債市周一並未擺脫「不妙的9月」，公債市場可能創下多年來最差的單月表現：9月以來，10年期殖利率已上升近48個基點，30年期殖利率則上升31個基點。

油價與升息預期 雙重力量推升殖利率

美債殖利率最新一波升勢，主因是周末有報導指出川普拒絕伊朗提出的停火方案，並預料在美國11月期中選舉後再次轟炸伊朗，這使油價應聲上漲，進一步鞏固通膨升溫和升息預期。
能源價格上漲，促使長天期債券持有人要求更高殖利率，以補償額外的不確定性，在此同時，市場預期聯準會(Fed)將進一步升息，也對短天期債券構成壓力。
根據芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具，聯準基金期貨交易員目前押注Fed 10月再升息1碼(25個基點)的機率接近75%，12月再升息的機率則為60%。
近期殖利率上升是多重因素共同發揮作用的結果，除了油價、通膨和升息預期以外，美國政府和人工智慧(AI)企業大量發債也是助長力量。此外，由於AI建設讓美國經濟強勁成長，投資人對債券的需求有所下滑。

小型股與殖利率敏感類股首當其衝

近期殖利率上升對小型股打擊尤其嚴重，其他對殖利率特別敏感的股市領域，如公用事業及營建商，也受到衝擊。即使是被視為不確定性時期經典避險資產的黃金，在近期大漲後也開始走弱。
投資人已注意到，債市波動率不斷升高，但股市相對平靜，兩者之間出現明顯背離。
Clark Capital Management Group固定收益主管Oliver Chambers接受MarketWatch電話訪問時表示：「我們應該開始看到股市對此做出反應。每當殖利率跳升50個基點，就應該開始對股市形成壓力。目前兩者的反應並不完全一致。」

企業信用市場恐先感受到壓力

然而，在股市真正感受到壓力之前，企業信用市場的債券可能已因大量發債而面臨壓力。
根據Glenmede彙整的數據，2026年美國公債與企業債券發行量預估將達到接近8兆美元的紀錄高點。AI超大規模資料中心業者(hyperscalers)今年來已發行約2470億美元債務，是2024年的12倍以上。
Glenmede投資策略與研究主管Jason Pride及投資策略副總裁Michael Reynolds說：「隨著政府與企業尋求融資，市場正在吸收前所未有的發債量，加劇對稀缺資本的競爭。」
Glenmede策略師團隊指出，儘管融資需求大幅增加，可用於滿足這些需求的儲蓄資金池成長速度卻慢得多，因此金融資產供給成長速度已超過可供吸收這些資產的資本。因此投資人可能要求更高的報酬，以換取資金。
他們補充指出：「這種更高的必要報酬，可能轉化為更低的資產價格，以及更高的未來預期報酬。」
paras_en: Wall Street had hoped that last week's bond market plunge was the worst it would see, but Monday's (the 28th) market performance suggests the situation may be even worse, as U.S. Treasury yields continued to climb to multi‑year highs. This not only drags down equities but also raises the cost of borrowing for U.S. consumers and businesses on mortgages, auto loans and credit‑card debt.

The 10‑year Treasury yield spiked to 5.27% intraday on Monday and closed at 5.241%, a peak not seen since June 2007, while the 30‑year yield rose six basis points to 5.561%, a 24‑year high. Both have risen for five consecutive trading days.

After a tough week, the U.S. bond market on Monday did not shake off a "troubled September," and the Treasury market may be posting its worst monthly performance in years: since September, the 10‑year yield has climbed nearly 48 basis points and the 30‑year yield up 31 basis points.

Higher oil prices and rate‑hike expectations are the twin forces pushing yields higher. The latest rally in Treasury yields was sparked by weekend reports that former President Trump rejected Iran's cease‑fire proposal and is expected to resume bombing Iran after the U.S. mid‑term elections in November, sending oil prices soaring and reinforcing inflation‑rise and rate‑hike expectations.

Rising energy prices are prompting long‑duration bond holders to demand higher yields to compensate for added uncertainty, while market expectations that the Federal Reserve will keep raising rates are also putting pressure on short‑duration bonds.

According to CME’s FedWatch tool, futures traders are currently betting that the Fed will raise rates by another 25‑basis‑point “step” in October with a probability close to 75%, and that a December hike has about a 60% chance.

The recent yield rise is the result of multiple factors working together; beyond oil, inflation and rate‑hike expectations, massive issuance by the U.S. government and AI companies is also fueling the move. Moreover, AI‑driven economic strength is dampening investors’ demand for bonds.

Small‑cap stocks and yield‑sensitive sectors are hit first. The recent yield climb has been especially painful for small‑cap stocks, and other yield‑sensitive areas such as utilities and builders have also felt the impact. Even gold, the classic safe‑haven in uncertain times, has begun to weaken after a recent rally.
Investors have noted that bond‑market volatility is rising steadily while the equity market remains relatively calm, creating a clear divergence between the two.

Oliver Chambers, head of fixed income at Clark Capital Management Group, told MarketWatch by phone: "We should start seeing the equity market react. Every time yields jump 50 basis points, pressure on stocks should begin to build. So far the reactions haven’t been fully aligned,"
Corporate credit markets may feel the pressure first, even before the equity market does, as a flood of new issuance could strain them.

Glenmede’s compiled data projects that U.S. Treasury and corporate bond issuance in 2026 will approach a record $8 trillion. AI hyperscalers have issued about $247 billion of debt this year, more than 12 times the amount issued in 2024.

Jason Pride, head of investment strategy and research at Glenmede, and investment strategy VP Michael Reynolds said, "As governments and corporations seek financing, the market is absorbing an unprecedented volume of issuance, intensifying competition for scarce capital."

Glenmede strategists note that although financing demand has surged, the pool of savings available to meet that demand is growing far more slowly, so the supply of financial assets now outpaces the capital able to absorb them, prompting investors to demand higher returns for providing funds.
They added, "This higher required return could translate into lower asset prices and higher expected future returns."

items.title: 特納斯上任就動刀！蘋果擬打破春秋兩季發表新品慣例
items.title_en: Ternus Moves Quickly After Taking the Helm! Apple Plans to Break Its Spring and Fall Product Launch Tradition
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US)新任執行長特納斯(John Ternus)上任數周後，已著手研議調整產品開發與組織架構，希望加快新品推出速度、擴大裝置陣容，並精簡管理層級。這些構想顯示，曾掌管硬體工程的特納斯，正試圖改變蘋果在庫克(Tim Cook)領導15年間建立的運作方式。
外媒周二(29日)引述知情人士報導，特納斯已在內部討論減少依賴春、秋兩季發表新品的慣例，改為全年更頻繁地推出產品。他認為，在人工智慧(AI)時代，蘋果必須加快開發並勇於嘗試新產品。不過，員工指出，改變行之多年的開發流程並不容易，可能需要數年才能完成。

加快新品節奏 精簡管理層級

蘋果明年規畫推出多款新裝置，包括配備相機的AirPods、首款智慧眼鏡，以及紀念iPhone問世20周年的重新設計機型。更密集的產品時程，也讓開發團隊面臨壓力。知情人士形容，主管如今更直接參與開發工作，團隊被要求在更短時間內推出更多產品。
在人事方面，蘋果硬體工程部門過去兩周已通知部分工程專案經理離職，受影響者包括約六名總監級員工。這些專案經理長期負責掌握開發時程、協調跨團隊工作。受影響員工只有數周時間尋找公司內部其他職位，未能轉任者將於今年稍晚遭到裁員。蘋果近月也縮減Siri、Vision Pro及部分AI軟體團隊，並提早收掉對營收貢獻較低的開發計畫。
特納斯也在探索如何以AI加快產品開發、處理部分員工工作。蘋果今年夏天曾研議裁撤約5,000名AppleCare客服人員，評估讓AI客服接手部分業務，但最終暫停該計畫，目前沒有執行打算。

服務成長放緩 尋找新收入

精簡組織之外，特納斯也與服務業務主管克佑(Eddy Cue)、財務長帕雷克(Kevan Parekh)討論推出新服務，並提高現有產品的收入。蘋果服務業務仍較去年同期成長，但今年第二季營收較前一季下滑，為2022年以來首見季減；App Store的營運模式也承受壓力。
零組件成本同樣增加。全球記憶體供應吃緊推高蘋果的採購支出，儘管公司已調漲部分產品價格，仍須自行吸收部分成本，以免漲價幅度嚇退顧客。對特納斯而言，更頻繁地推出新品，既能帶動裝置銷售，也可能為新服務吸引使用者，但組織調整與成本控管仍將持續。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) new CEO John Ternus, just weeks into his tenure, has already begun discussing adjustments to product development and organizational structure, aiming to speed up new product releases, expand the device lineup, and streamline management layers. These ideas show that Ternus, who previously oversaw hardware engineering, is trying to change the operating model Apple has built over Tim Cook’s 15‑year leadership.

Foreign media on Tuesday (the 29th) quoted insiders saying Ternus is discussing internally reducing reliance on the traditional spring and fall product launches, shifting to more frequent releases throughout the year. He believes that in the AI era Apple must accelerate development and be bold in trying new products. However, employees note that altering a decades‑long development process won’t be easy and could take several years to complete.

Accelerating the product cadence and flattening management layers Apple plans to roll out multiple new devices next year, including camera‑equipped AirPods, its first smart glasses, and a redesigned model to mark the iPhone’s 20th anniversary. The tighter schedule puts pressure on development teams. Insiders say managers are now more directly involved in the work, and teams are being asked to deliver more products in shorter timeframes.

On the personnel side, Apple’s hardware engineering division has notified several project managers of termination over the past two weeks, affecting about six director‑level employees. These managers have long been responsible for tracking development timelines and coordinating cross‑team work. Affected staff have only a few weeks to find other internal roles; those who cannot be reassigned will be laid off later this year. Apple has also recently trimmed Siri, Vision Pro, and parts of its AI software teams, and has prematurely shut down lower‑revenue development projects.

Ternus is also exploring how AI can speed up product development and handle some employee tasks. This summer Apple considered cutting roughly 5,000 AppleCare support staff and evaluating AI‑driven customer service, but the plan was paused and there are currently no implementation plans.

Beyond organizational slimming, Ternus has been discussing new services and ways to boost revenue from existing products with services chief Eddy Cue and CFO Kevin Parekh. Apple’s services business still grew year‑over‑year, but second‑quarter revenue fell versus the prior quarter—the first quarterly decline since 2022—and the App Store’s operating model is under pressure.

Component costs are also rising. Global memory shortages have pushed Apple’s procurement expenses higher; even though the company has raised prices on some products, it still absorbs part of the cost to avoid scaring customers with steep price hikes. For Ternus, more frequent product launches can drive device sales and attract users to new services, but organizational adjustments and cost control will remain ongoing challenges.

items.title: 油價漲、Fed恐再升息！美債遭拋售 30年期公債殖利率創24年新高
items.title_en: Oil Prices Rise, Fed May Hike Again! US Bonds Sold Off as 30-Year Treasury Yield Hits 24-Year High
paras: 美國公債賣壓持續升溫，30年期公債殖利率周二(29日)連續第六個交易日攀升，一度觸及5.613%，創2002年以來最高。中東戰事推高能源價格，市場憂心通膨再起、聯準會(Fed)繼續升息；企業債發行增加及美國財政疑慮，也加重債市壓力。
截稿前，30年期公債殖利率盤中報5.609%，較前一交易日上升約4個基點。10年期公債殖利率升至約5.285%，處於2007年以來高檔；2年期殖利率約4.922%。公債價格與殖利率走勢相反。
美伊戰爭已持續約七個月，油價居高不下，使投資人擔心物價壓力延續。本月Fed以12比0全員一致升息1碼後，交易員目前押注10月會議再次升息的機率超過72%。美國經濟活動強勁及政府債務規模，也讓公債殖利率進一步走高。
這波跌勢不只衝擊長天期公債。根據《彭博》指數，美國公債今年迄今下跌2.6%，相較去年上漲6.3%。花旗策略師形容，債市正經歷「輕度買方罷工」；知名美國獨立金融市場與總體經濟研究機構雅迪尼研究(Yardeni Research)則認為，以日元融資投資高收益資產的套利交易平倉，也助長全球債券拋售。
季節因素可能使賣壓延續。過去十年，美國公債9月跌幅中位數為0.9%，10月為0.7%。道明證券策略師Prashant Newnaha警告，若中東局勢遲遲無法化解，固定收益市場可能持續降低風險部位，賣壓甚至蔓延至股市。道富投資管理公司策略師Masahiko Loo指出，秋季公債供給回升，加上企業發債與AI資本支出需求，將使資金競爭更加激烈。
不過，也有投資人認為債市已跌過頭。華爾街資深人士Jim Bianco六年來首次看好美國公債，RBC BlueBay投資長Mark Dowding則認為，全球債券遭到過度拋售。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury selling pressure continued to heat up, with the 30-year Treasury yield climbing for the sixth consecutive trading day on Tuesday (the 29th), briefly reaching 5.613% – the highest level since 2002. The Middle East conflict has pushed energy prices higher, sparking market worries about a resurgence of inflation and further Fed rate hikes; increased corporate bond issuance and concerns over U.S. fiscal health have also added pressure to the bond market.

At the time of writing, the 30-year Treasury yield was trading at 5.609% intraday, about four basis points higher than the previous session. The 10-year yield rose to roughly 5.285%, a peak not seen since 2007, while the 2-year yield was about 4.922%. Treasury prices move inversely to yields.

The U.S.-Iran war has now lasted about seven months, and persistently high oil prices are making investors worry that price pressures will continue. After the Fed unanimously raised rates by one quarter-point this month (12‑0 vote), traders are now betting that the October meeting will see another hike with a probability exceeding 72%. Strong U.S. economic activity and the size of government debt are also pushing Treasury yields higher.

The sell‑off is not limited to long‑dated bonds. According to Bloomberg data, U.S. Treasuries are down 2.6% year‑to‑date, compared with a 6.3% gain last year. Citi strategists described the bond market as undergoing a “mild buyer strike,” while the independent research firm Yardeni Research said that the unwinding of yen‑funded arbitrage trades into high‑yield assets is further fueling the global bond sell‑off.

Seasonal factors may keep the pressure on. Over the past decade, the median September decline for U.S. Treasuries has been 0.9% and the median October decline 0.7%. TD Securities strategist Prashant Newnaha warned that if the Middle East situation remains unresolved, the fixed‑income market could keep trimming risk positions, with selling pressure potentially spilling over into equities. State Street Global Advisors strategist Masahiko Loo noted that autumn Treasury supply is picking up, and combined with corporate issuance and AI‑driven capital spending, competition for funding will intensify.

Nevertheless, some investors think the bond market has oversold. Wall Street veteran Jim Bianco is bullish on U.S. Treasuries for the first time in six years, and RBC BlueBay’s chief investment officer Mark Dowding believes global bonds have been sold off excessively.

items.title: 美國8月職缺降至5個月低點！低裁員撐住就業 Fed仍有升息空間
items.title_en: U.S. August Job Openings Drop to Five-Month Low; Low Layoffs Support Employment, Fed Still Has Rate‑Hike Room
paras: 美國8月職缺降至五個月低點，連續第三個月不如市場預期，但裁員人數也降至2025年3月以來最低，招聘則小幅回升，顯示勞動市場仍處於「低招聘、低裁員」格局。企業擴編意願雖偏弱，卻未出現大規模裁員，讓聯準會(Fed)仍有空間優先對抗通膨。
美國勞工統計局周二(29日)公布職缺與勞動力流動調查(JOLTS)，8月職缺減少25.6萬個至707.9萬個，低於市場預估的約722萬個。7月數據由727.1萬個上修至733.5萬個，8月職缺率則從4.4%降至4.3%。

職缺縮減遍及多個產業 求職與轉職機會收窄

職缺減少涵蓋專業與商業服務、醫療與社會援助、州與地方政府，以及製造業和營建業；貿易、資訊、休閒與餐旅業則增加。其中，房地產與租賃業職缺銳減近半至5萬個，創2014年2月以來最低，顯示部分產業用人需求明顯轉弱。
每名失業者對應的職缺數，也由7月約1.1個降至約1個，遠低於2022年高峰的2個。這項Fed密切追蹤的指標，反映勞動供需大致平衡，但也意味求職者不再擁有過去那麼多選擇。
8月主動離職人數減少2.3萬人至306.6萬人，離職率維持1.9%，追平2020年以來最低，反映勞工對找到更好工作的信心不足。企業招聘意願偏低，使在職者不敢輕易跳槽，待業者也更難進入市場。同日公布的9月消費者信心降至2014年以來最低，民眾對就業前景也更悲觀。

低裁員支撐就業穩定 Fed仍有升息空間

不過，求職難度增加，尚未演變成裁員潮。8月招聘增加4.6萬人至519.2萬人，招聘率由3.2%升至3.3%；裁員與解僱減少6.1萬人至164.1萬人，相關比率從1.1%降至1%。初領失業救濟金人數也維持歷史低檔附近，顯示企業仍傾向留住現有人力。
經濟學家認為，美伊戰爭帶來的不確定性，是企業不願擴大招聘的原因之一。能源價格攀升推高通膨，柴油價格更創歷史新高，恐進一步拖累經濟。這使Fed面臨兩面考驗：招聘疲弱值得留意，但低裁員與穩定的失業率，仍讓官員有餘裕處理物價壓力。
Fed本月升息1碼，將基準利率調至3.75%至4%，為三年來首次升息，並暗示後續可能續升。根據芝商所FedWatch工具數據，市場押注10月再升息的機率約70.3%。
周五(10/2)公布的9月非農就業報告，將進一步檢驗勞動市場韌性。市場預估新增就業9萬人，低於8月的16.2萬人，失業率則維持4.1%。若招聘放緩卻未推升失業率，Fed仍有理由聚焦通膨；若就業明顯惡化，後續升息的取捨就會更複雜。不過，JOLTS回覆率較疫情前明顯下降，且與非農統計口徑不同，仍須搭配其他數據判讀，不能僅憑職缺減少就斷言就業將失速。
paras_en: U.S. August job openings fell to a five‑month low, marking the third consecutive month they missed market expectations, while layoffs also fell to their lowest level since March 2025 and hiring rebounded slightly, indicating the labor market remains in a "low hiring, low layoffs" pattern. Although firms' willingness to expand is weak, there has been no wave of large‑scale layoffs, leaving the Federal Reserve room to prioritize fighting inflation.

The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics released the Job Openings and Labor Turnover Survey (JOLTS) on Tuesday (the 29th). August job openings declined by 256,000 to 7.079 million, below the market forecast of roughly 7.22 million. July’s figure was revised up from 7.271 million to 7.335 million, and the August job‑opening rate fell from 4.4% to 4.3%.

Job cuts were seen across many sectors, narrowing job‑search and career‑change opportunities. Openings fell in professional and business services, health care and social assistance, state and local government, as well as manufacturing and construction, while trade, information, leisure and hospitality added jobs. Notably, real‑estate and rental openings plunged almost half to 50,000, the lowest since February 2014, showing a clear weakening in demand for workers in some industries.

The number of job openings per unemployed worker dropped from about 1.1 in July to roughly 1 in August, far below the 2022 peak of 2. This Fed‑watched indicator suggests labor supply and demand are roughly balanced, but also means job seekers no longer have as many choices as before.

August voluntary quits fell by 23,000 to 3.066 million, keeping the quit rate at 1.9%—a low tied with the post‑2020 minimum—reflecting workers’ lack of confidence in finding better jobs. Weak hiring appetite makes employed workers reluctant to switch jobs and makes the unemployed find it harder to enter the market. On the same day, September consumer confidence slid to its lowest since 2014, deepening pessimism about employment prospects.

Low layoffs are supporting employment stability, and the Fed still has room to raise rates. Yet job‑search difficulty has risen, though it has not turned into a layoff wave. August hires rose by 46,000 to 5.192 million, lifting the hiring rate from 3.2% to 3.3%; layoffs and discharges fell by 61,000 to 1.641 million, dropping the related rate from 1.1% to 1%. Initial unemployment benefit claims also stayed near historic lows, showing firms still prefer to retain existing staff.

Economists say the uncertainty from the U.S.–Iran conflict is one reason firms are reluctant to expand hiring. Rising energy prices are pushing inflation higher, with diesel hitting record highs and threatening further economic drag. This puts the Fed in a two‑sided dilemma: weak hiring warrants attention, but low layoffs and a stable unemployment rate give officials leeway to address price pressures.

The Fed raised its policy rate by one quarter‑point this month, moving the target range to 3.75%–4.00%, the first hike in three years, and signaled that further increases are possible. According to CME’s FedWatch tool, the market assigns roughly a 70.3% probability to another hike in October.

The September non‑farm payroll report, due Friday (Oct 2), will further test labor‑market resilience. Analysts expect 90,000 new jobs, down from August’s 162,000, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.1%. If hiring slows without pushing the unemployment rate up, the Fed can keep its focus on inflation; if employment deteriorates sharply, the calculus for further hikes becomes more complex. However, JOLTS response rates have fallen noticeably since the pandemic and its coverage differs from the payroll survey, so the data must be read alongside other indicators and not be used alone to claim that employment is about to stall.

items.title: 貿易摩擦加劇 美國對近10億美元加拿大商品進口禁令正式生效
items.title_en: Trade Friction Escalates as U.S. Ban on Nearly $1 Billion Worth of Canadian Imports Takes Effect
paras: 美國在29日（周二）凌晨起正式實施針對加拿大部分商品的進口禁令，涉及酒類、乳製品和摩托車等，預計涉及約9.67億美元加拿大對美出口。
此次禁令是川普政府對加拿大採取的一系列貿易措施的最新升級。美國與加拿大兩國年度雙邊貿易額約8,800億美元，因此此次禁令涉及的規模相對有限。
美國貿易律師帕特里克·柴爾德里斯表示，此舉不會緩解美加貿易緊張局勢。他認為，由於相關商品此前已經面臨美國加徵關稅，其中部分商品實際上已經因高關稅而難以進入美國市場。
美國智庫美國行動論壇貿易政策主管雅各布·詹森估算，此次禁令涉及的加拿大商品價值約9.67億美元，其中約87%為酒類，包括啤酒、烈酒、氣泡酒、白蘭地、清酒等。
此外，部分乳製品以及摩托車也在禁令範圍內。
加拿大此前已針對美國關稅採取反制措施。此次進口禁令可能進一步加劇美加貿易摩擦，並增添兩國圍繞《美國—墨西哥—加拿大協定》（USMCA）續簽談判的不確定性。
美加近來貿易爭端不斷。川普政府從8月22日開始對從加拿大進口的紅酒、水泥等數百項特定商品加徵50%關稅。加拿大政府隨後宣布對美國實施「等額、對等」反制，從9月8日起對價值約200億美元700多種美國商品加徵反制關稅。
據美國白宮16日發布的消息，美國總統川普當天簽署一份總統備忘錄，將源自加拿大的產品排除出美國政府採購計畫。
paras_en: On the early morning of Tuesday the 29th, the United States formally began enforcing an import ban on certain Canadian goods, covering alcohol, dairy products and motorcycles, and affecting roughly $967 million in Canadian exports to the U.S.

The ban represents the latest escalation in a series of trade measures taken by the Trump administration against Canada. With annual bilateral trade between the two countries around $880 billion, the scope of this ban is relatively modest.

U.S. trade lawyer Patrick Schilderis said the move will not ease the tension in U.S.-Canada trade relations. He noted that many of the affected products were already subject to U.S. tariffs, and some of them are effectively barred from the U.S. market because of the high duties.

Jacob Jensen, head of trade policy at the American Action Forum, estimated the value of Canadian goods covered by the ban at about $967 million, with roughly 87 % of that consisting of alcoholic beverages such as beer, spirits, sparkling wine, brandy and sake.
In addition, certain dairy products and motorcycles are also included in the ban’s scope.

Canada has previously taken retaliatory steps against U.S. tariffs. This new import ban could further heighten U.S.-Canada trade friction and add uncertainty to the ongoing negotiations over the renewal of the United States‑Mexico‑Canada Agreement (USMCA).

Recent U.S.-Canada trade disputes have been frequent. Since August 22, the Trump administration has imposed a 50 % tariff on hundreds of specific Canadian items, including red wine and cement. Canada responded by announcing “equal‑and‑reciprocal” retaliation, imposing counter‑tariffs on more than 700 U.S. products worth about $20 billion starting September 8.
According to a White House release on the 16th, President Trump signed a presidential memorandum that excludes products originating from Canada from U.S. government procurement programs.

items.title: 〈台幣〉節後股匯齊挫 貶近1角收31.876元探近2周新低
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Falls Over 0.1 TWD After Holiday, Closes at 31.876 Near Two‑Week Low
paras: 中秋連假過後首個交易日，台北股匯今(29)日連袂走弱，大盤跌破 4 萬 8，新台幣兌美元一度貶逾 1 角，摜破 31.9 元關卡，終場貶勢略見收斂，收在 31.876 元，貶值 9.6 分，為連三黑，創近 2 周新低，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值放大至 28.515 億美元。
美債遭遇 2 年來最重的單月拋售潮，10年期殖利率一度突破 5.27%，創 19 年新高，2年期也逼近 5%。與此同時，美伊關係未見緩和，國際油價持續走高，市場認為通膨可能進一步升高，迫使聯準會進一步緊縮貨幣政策，亞洲股市今天多半走跌。
中秋連假期間，國際股市普遍走弱，台股今天開盤展開補跌，權王台積電力守平盤，但聯發科、台達電、國巨*等權值股賣壓沉重，加權指數終場收在47631.96點，下跌392.64點，外資賣超 632 億元。
新台幣兌美元今天開盤價為31.8元，隨著熱錢流出，匯價一度重貶 1.45 角，最低下探 31.925 元，不過，適逢月底，出口商有實質拋匯需求，帶動新台幣貶幅收斂，終場收在 31.876 元，貶值 9.6 分。
觀察主要貨幣對美元9/24-9/29表現，根據央行統計，美元指數累計上漲 0.33%，韓元升值 0.61%，日元升值 0.53%，人民幣升值 0.14%，星幣微幅升值 0.02%，新台幣則相對走疲，貶值 0.30%。
paras_en: After the Mid‑Autumn holiday, the first trading day saw both the Taipei stock and foreign‑exchange markets weaken together. The main index slipped below 48,000 points and the New Taiwan dollar briefly fell more than 0.1 TWD per US$—breaking the 31.9 TWD barrier—before ending slightly less weak at 31.876, a depreciation of 9.6 cents. This marked a third consecutive down day and a near‑two‑week low, while total turnover in the Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange market expanded to US$2.8515 billion.

U.S. Treasury bonds experienced their heaviest monthly sell‑off in two years, with the 10‑year yield briefly topping 5.27%, a 19‑year high, and the 2‑year yield approaching 5%. At the same time, U.S.–Iran tensions showed no sign of easing and global oil prices kept rising, prompting expectations that inflation could climb further and the Federal Reserve would tighten monetary policy even more, leading most Asian equity markets lower today.

During the Mid‑Autumn break, international equity markets generally weakened. The Taiwan market opened lower to continue the decline. TSMC managed to hold near the flat line, but heavy selling hit heavyweight stocks such as MediaTek, Delta Electronics and Yageo, dragging the weighted index down to 47,631.96 points, down 392.64 points, with foreign investors net selling NT$63.2 billion.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at 31.8 per US$ today. As hot money fled, the rate briefly plunged another 0.145 TWD to a low of 31.925, but end‑of‑month export‑related foreign‑exchange demand helped curb the depreciation, and the dollar closed at 31.876, down 9.6 cents.

Looking at major currency pairs against the US dollar from 9/24‑9/29, central‑bank data show the dollar index rose 0.33%, the Korean won appreciated 0.61%, the yen 0.53%, the renminbi 0.14%, the Singapore dollar 0.02%, while the New Taiwan dollar weakened relative to the dollar, depreciating 0.30%.

items.title: 日本升息至31年新高但日元竟反貶 2.3兆美元套利交易成全球金融潛在火藥桶
items.title_en: Japan Raises Rates to 31-Year High Yet Yen Depreciates; $2.3 Trillion Arbitrage Becomes Global Financial Powder Keg
paras: 日本央行本月將政策利率調升至 1.25%，創下 31 年來新高，然而日元匯率未升反貶，美元兌日元一度衝破 158 關卡。主因在於美國聯準會重啟升息，使美日利差依舊顯著，加上日銀以 7 比 2 的表決結果決議升息，未達市場預期的鷹派立場，反而放大了市場拋售日元的壓力。
有些人認為，即使日本當局干預外匯市場，也無法保證日元持續走強。瑞銀資產管理全球主權及貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，如果日本當局再次出手捍衛日元，他將藉此機會拋售日元。
他指出，儘管市場預期日本央行明年6月前將升息至多3次，但聯準會同期也預計升息3次。 「如果聯準會降息時美元兌日元匯率都沒有下跌，那麼聯準會升息時又怎麼可能大幅下跌呢？」
在長期低利率環境下，全球「日元套利交易」規模已劇烈膨脹。根據統計，跨境日元借款規模在過去3年半大增 67%，達到 360 兆日元(約 2.3 兆美元)。投資人與機構法人借入低利日元後，轉而投入高殖利率的美元資產與美股市場，藉此賺取利差與匯差回報。
這股巨大的套利資金已成為全球金融市場的潛在「平倉火藥桶」。日銀目前面臨極大的政策兩難：若升息節奏過慢，利差誘因將讓套利交易持續擴大；但若升息過快引發日元急升，將觸發投資人為止損而大量賣出海外資產並買回日元，引發連鎖平倉潮。
2024 年夏天日銀意外升息時，就曾導致日經指數單日暴跌 12.4%，衝擊全球股市。瑞銀策略師James Malcolm估計，當時美元兌日元套息交易的峰值規模至少為5000億美元，其中約2000億美元在兩到三周內進行了平倉。他解釋說：「決定平倉規模的並非利差的絕對水準，而是利差變化的速度。」
paras_en: The Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% this month, a 31‑year high, but the yen fell instead of rising, with the dollar‑yen pair briefly breaking the 158 level. The main reason is the Fed’s resumption of rate hikes, keeping the US‑Japan yield gap sizable, and the BOJ’s 7‑to‑2 vote to raise rates fell short of market‑expected hawkishness, amplifying pressure to sell the yen.

Some argue that even if Japanese authorities intervene in the FX market, they cannot guarantee a sustained yen rally. Kevin Zhao, head of global sovereign and currency fixed‑income at UBS Asset Management, said that if the authorities step in to defend the yen, he would use the chance to sell the currency.

He noted that while markets expect the BOJ to hike up to three times before June next year, the Fed is also projected to raise rates three times in the same period. “If the dollar‑yen rate doesn’t fall when the Fed cuts, how could it drop sharply when the Fed hikes?”

In a prolonged low‑rate environment, the global “yen carry‑trade” has ballooned. Statistics show cross‑border yen borrowing has surged 67% over the past three‑and‑a‑half years to 360 trillion yen (about $2.3 trillion). Investors and institutional entities borrow cheap yen and invest in higher‑yielding dollar assets and US equities, earning both interest‑rate and currency‑exchange returns.

This massive arbitrage flow has become a potential “liquidation powder keg” for world markets. The BOJ now faces a stark policy dilemma: if rate hikes are too slow, the yield differential will keep expanding carry‑trade volumes; if hikes are too fast and the yen spikes, investors may rush to unwind overseas positions and buy back yen, triggering a cascade of liquidations.

When the BOJ unexpectedly raised rates in the summer of 2024, the Nikkei plunged 12.4% in a single day, rattling global equity markets. UBS strategist James Malcolm estimated that at the time the peak size of the dollar‑yen carry‑trade was at least $500 billion, with roughly $200 billion unwound within two to three weeks. He explained, “The scale of unwindings is driven not by the absolute level of the spread but by the speed of its change.”

items.title: 歐元兌美元跌近1.14關卡 能源價格成歐元最大變數 ECB面臨通膨與成長兩難
items.title_en: Euro Near 1.14 Against Dollar as Energy Prices Become Biggest Variable; ECB Faces Inflation‑Growth Dilemma
paras: 歐元今年以來相對美元展現的韌性，如今正面臨能源價格飆升與歐洲政治風險的雙重考驗。《路透社》分析指出，歐元近期已回落至相對低位，市場開始重新評估，在中東衝突推高能源成本、歐洲經濟面臨壓力，以及美國利率前景重新受到關注的情況下，歐元能否延續今年以來的升勢。
歐元兌美元 9 月 25 日收在約 1.1400 美元，較 9 月 10 日的約 1.1616 美元明顯回落。9 月 24 日一度降至約 1.1367 美元，顯示近期美元重新取得部分優勢。9 月 29 日亞洲早盤，歐元兌美元約在 1.1370 美元附近波動。
今年歐元原本受惠於美元走弱、歐洲財政支出增加，以及市場對美元作為全球主要儲備貨幣地位的重新評估，一度呈現相對強勢。然而，近期中東局勢升溫重新推高原油及天然氣價格，歐洲作為能源淨進口地區，受到的衝擊遠大於美國，因為美國本身是能源生產及出口大國。
能源價格上升對歐元區形成雙重壓力。一方面，較高的能源成本會推高進口帳單並惡化貿易條件；另一方面，能源價格持續上升又會推升通膨，使歐洲中央銀行(ECB)面臨更複雜的政策取捨。如果 ECB 因通膨壓力而維持較緊縮的貨幣政策，將可能進一步壓抑經濟成長；但若能源衝擊造成經濟明顯放緩，持續升息同樣存在政策風險。
ECB 副總裁 Boris Vujcic 9 月中受訪時表示，能源價格已明顯高於 ECB 9 月經濟預測所採用的基準假設，市場對未來利率路徑的定價主要受到能源價格上升推動。他指出，市場目前預期能源價格將在更長時間維持高檔，而非此前預期的中東緊張局勢緩解後逐步回落。
ECB 9 月公布的最新預測也顯示能源衝擊正在改變歐元區經濟前景。基準情境假設 2026 年第 3 季原油價格平均約為每桶 88 美元，天然氣價格約為每百萬瓦時 60 歐元。不過，在較不利情境下，2026 年第 4 季原油價格可能升至約每桶 99 美元，天然氣價格升至約每百萬瓦時 77 歐元；在嚴重情境下，原油價格可能升至約每桶 132 美元，天然氣價格更可能達到每百萬瓦時 130 歐元。
ECB估算，在嚴重能源衝擊情境下，全球原油供應量可能較基準情境減少約8%，液化天然氣(LNG)供應量可能減少約12%，相當於全球每天約800萬桶原油及每月約50億立方公尺LNG的供應缺口。
這對歐元而言尤其重要，因為能源價格不只是通膨問題，也會直接影響歐元區經常帳、企業成本及家庭實質所得。ECB指出，油價上升對通膨的傳導通常更快，而天然氣價格則可能透過家庭能源帳單及企業投入成本產生更持久的影響。
市場因此開始重新評估歐元今年以來的升值是否具有足夠的基本面支撐。即使能源價格上升促使 ECB 採取更強硬的貨幣政策，升息本身也未必能推升歐元，因為市場可能同時擔憂能源衝擊對歐元區經濟成長造成的負面影響。
ECB 9 月的政策聲明已指出，經濟成長風險偏向下行，主要原因包括中東衝突及俄烏戰爭。如果能源供應再次受到干擾，能源價格可能進一步上升並維持更長時間，進而壓縮實質所得、消費及投資。
通膨風險則偏向上行。ECB指出，若能源價格長期維持高檔，能源衝擊可能逐漸透過間接及第二輪效應擴散至其他商品及薪資。天然氣尤其受到關注，若供應進一步受限或歐洲冬季異常寒冷且天然氣庫存偏低，價格可能再度大幅上升。
除了能源價格之外，歐洲政治風險也是歐元近期需要面對的另一項變數。法國財政狀況、政府穩定性以及歐洲主要國家的財政政策，都可能影響投資人對歐洲資產的風險評價。
法國是歐元區第二大經濟體，其財政赤字及政府政策的不確定性長期受到市場關注。若法國政府面臨更大的政治壓力，或財政整頓計畫受到阻礙，可能推高法國與德國公債殖利率差，進而增加歐洲金融市場的風險溢價。
這項風險也可能透過歐洲債券市場傳導至匯市。若投資人因政治及財政不確定性要求更高風險溢價，歐元資產的吸引力可能受到影響，即使 ECB 維持相對緊縮的政策立場，也不一定能完全抵消政治風險。
另一方面，美國利率前景同樣是決定歐元兌美元走勢的重要因素。市場目前密切關注聯準會(Fed)是否因能源價格及通膨風險重新調整利率政策。若美國通膨受到能源價格推升，聯準會降息速度可能慢於市場此前預期，美元將獲得利率差優勢。
相較之下，ECB也可能面臨能源價格造成的「滯脹」型衝擊，即通膨升高的同時經濟成長放緩。這使 ECB 的政策選擇比單純面對需求型通膨更加複雜，也可能限制歐元因升息預期而獲得的支撐。
目前歐元仍有部分結構性支撐。歐洲國家持續增加國防及基礎建設支出，歐盟推動單一市場改革及生產力提升，也可能改善中長期經濟成長。此外，若美元因美國財政赤字、貿易政策或聯準會政策不確定性而遭遇新的壓力，歐元仍可能重新獲得資金流入。
不過，市場目前更關注的是能源衝擊能否受到控制。如果中東衝突逐步降溫，原油及天然氣價格回落，歐元區受到的貿易條件衝擊也會減輕，歐元有機會重新受惠於美元自身的結構性問題。
反過來，如果能源價格持續升高，歐洲冬季又面臨天然氣庫存不足的問題，歐元可能同時承受經濟成長放緩、通膨升高及政治風險增加的壓力。這種組合將使歐元今年以來相對美元的韌性面臨更嚴峻考驗。
ECB最新預測也提供了市場衡量風險的參考。在較溫和情境下，2026 年第 4 季原油價格約為每桶 76 美元、天然氣約每百萬瓦時 50 歐元；不利情境則分別升至約 99 美元及 77 歐元；嚴重情境更可能升至約 132 美元及 130 歐元。這意味著能源價格路徑將成為左右歐洲通膨、經濟成長與貨幣政策的重要變數。
歐元今年以來的升勢因此進入新的測試階段。美元是否重新取得更明顯的避險及利率優勢，將取決於能源價格、中東局勢、美國與歐洲央行政策差異，以及歐洲自身的政治與財政穩定性。對歐元而言，單靠 ECB 的利率政策已不足以解釋匯率走勢，能源與政治風險正重新成為決定歐元兌美元方向的重要因素。
paras_en: The euro’s resilience against the dollar so far this year is now being tested by soaring energy prices and European political risks. Reuters analysis notes that the euro has recently slipped to relatively low levels, prompting the market to reassess whether it can sustain its year‑to‑date gains amid higher Middle‑East‑driven energy costs, pressure on the European economy and renewed focus on U.S. rate outlooks.

The euro‑dollar pair closed on September 25 at about 1.1400, down sharply from roughly 1.1616 on September 10. It fell to around 1.1367 on September 24, showing the dollar regaining some ground. In early Asian trading on September 29 the pair hovered near 1.1370.

Earlier this year the euro benefited from a weaker dollar, increased European fiscal spending and a reassessment of the dollar’s role as the world’s primary reserve currency, giving the euro relative strength. However, the recent escalation of Middle‑East tensions has pushed oil and gas prices higher, hitting Europe— a net energy importer— harder than the United States, which is a major energy producer and exporter.

Rising energy prices create a double‑edged pressure on the euro area. Higher energy costs raise import bills and worsen trade terms, while persistent price increases also feed inflation, putting the European Central Bank (ECB) in a tougher policy dilemma. If the ECB keeps policy tight to combat inflation, growth could be further dampened; but if the energy shock slows the economy markedly, continued rate hikes also carry policy risk.

ECB Vice‑President Boris Vujcic said in a mid‑September interview that energy prices are already well above the baseline assumptions used in the ECB’s September economic forecasts, and that market pricing of future rate paths is now driven mainly by rising energy costs. He noted that markets now expect energy prices to stay high for a longer period rather than gradually falling after any easing of Middle‑East tensions.

The ECB’s September outlook shows the energy shock reshaping the euro‑area outlook. The baseline scenario assumes average crude oil at about $88 per barrel and gas at €60 per MWh in Q3 2026. In a less favourable scenario, oil could rise to roughly $99 per barrel and gas to €77 per MWh by Q4 2026; in a severe scenario, oil may reach about $132 per barrel and gas €130 per MWh.

In a severe energy‑shock scenario the ECB estimates global crude supply could fall about 8% relative to the baseline, and LNG supply about 12%, equivalent to a daily shortfall of roughly 8 million barrels of oil and a monthly gap of about 5 billion cubic metres of LNG.

This matters especially for the euro because energy prices affect not only inflation but also the euro‑area current account, corporate costs and household real incomes. The ECB notes that oil price hikes transmit to inflation more quickly, while gas price changes can have a more lasting impact through household energy bills and business input costs.

Markets are therefore re‑evaluating whether the euro’s year‑to‑date appreciation has solid fundamentals. Even if higher energy prices push the ECB toward a tougher stance, rate hikes alone may not lift the euro, as investors may also worry about the negative growth impact of the energy shock on the euro area.

The ECB’s September policy statement flagged that growth risks are tilted to the downside, driven mainly by the Middle‑East conflict and the Russia‑Ukraine war. A renewed disruption to energy supplies could push prices higher for longer, squeezing real incomes, consumption and investment.

Inflation risks, by contrast, are tilted upward. The ECB warns that if energy prices stay high, the shock could gradually spread to other goods and wages through indirect and second‑round effects. Gas is especially watched; further supply constraints or an unusually cold European winter with low inventories could trigger another sharp price surge.

Beyond energy, European political risk is another variable the euro must face. France’s fiscal situation, government stability and fiscal policies in major European economies can all affect investors’ risk assessment of European assets.

France, the euro area’s second‑largest economy, has long drawn market attention for its fiscal deficit and policy uncertainty. Heightened political pressure on the French government or setbacks to fiscal consolidation could widen the yield spread between French and German bonds, raising risk premia across European financial markets.

That risk can spill over into the foreign‑exchange market via the European bond market. If investors demand higher risk premia because of political and fiscal uncertainty, the attractiveness of euro‑denominated assets may weaken, and even a relatively tight ECB stance may not fully offset the political risk.

On the other hand, U.S. rate expectations remain a key driver of the euro‑dollar trajectory. Markets are watching closely whether the Federal Reserve will adjust its policy in response to higher energy‑driven inflation. If U.S. inflation stays elevated, the Fed may cut rates more slowly than previously expected, giving the dollar a rate‑differential edge.

Conversely, the ECB could confront a “stagflation”‑type shock from energy, where inflation rises while growth slows. This makes the ECB’s policy choices more complex than dealing with pure demand‑driven inflation and may limit the euro’s support from rate‑hike expectations.

The euro still enjoys some structural support. Ongoing increases in defence and infrastructure spending across Europe, EU‑wide single‑market reforms and productivity initiatives could boost medium‑ to long‑term growth. Moreover, if the dollar faces new pressures from U.S. fiscal deficits, trade policies or Fed uncertainty, capital could flow back into the euro.

However, markets are now more focused on whether the energy shock can be contained. If the Middle‑East conflict cools and oil and gas prices retreat, the trade‑term impact on the euro area would ease, giving the euro a chance to benefit again from the dollar’s own structural issues.

Conversely, if energy prices keep climbing and Europe faces a gas‑short winter, the euro could be hit simultaneously by slower growth, higher inflation and heightened political risk. This combination would test the euro’s resilience against the dollar more severely than earlier this year.

The ECB’s latest forecasts also give a benchmark for risk assessment. In a mild scenario, Q4 2026 oil is projected at about $76 per barrel and gas at €50 per MWh; in an adverse scenario they rise to roughly $99 and €77 respectively; in a severe scenario they could reach about $132 and €130. This underscores that the energy price path will be a key driver of European inflation, growth and monetary policy.

The euro’s year‑to‑date rally now enters a new testing phase. Whether the dollar regains a clearer safe‑haven and rate advantage will depend on energy prices, the Middle‑East situation, U.S. versus European central‑bank policy differences, and Europe’s own political and fiscal stability. For the euro, ECB rate policy alone can no longer explain exchange‑rate moves; energy and political risks are re‑emerging as decisive factors.

paras: 美元兌日元匯率在今(29)日亞洲早盤交易時段狹幅波動，交投於157.35附近，日本財務大臣片山皋月當天表示，日元疲軟仍是持續存在的擔憂，日美雙方將保持密切聯繫，以尋求維護外匯市場秩序。
片山說：「正如高市早苗在最近於紐約舉行的日美峰會上所言，我也認為，日元被低估是一個問題，我們將繼續保持日美金融當局之間的密切溝通，並致力於維持外匯市場的有序運行。」
片山皋月發表上述言論前，她上周五(25日)曾與美國財長貝森特通話，日美雙方重申對日元被低估的共同關切，並同意進一步加強合作。
此前，美日兩國已於8月初確認實施聯合干預以支持日元。片山最新發言與貝森特的觀點高度呼應，顯示美日雙方在日元匯率議題上的立場進一步趨於一致。雙方不僅重申了對日元低估的共同擔憂，還確認繼續協調溝通的意願，這為市場傳遞出明確信號：美日雙方正就匯市動向保持高度同步，並準備在必要時採取協調行動，以維護匯率穩定與市場秩序。
片山最新表態旨在打消市場對日本政府有意壓低日元、推高通膨的猜測。若市場認為政府樂見日元疲軟，日元下行壓力會顯著加大，而當前明確的否認有助於緩解此類擔憂，在一定程度上對日元形成支撐。
片山還強調，利率水準最終由市場決定，並否認高市政府是再通膨主義的，強調利率由市場決定，且稱財務省將與債券市場參與者密切溝通。同樣，「有序」市場的表述屬於官方標準措辭，顯示東京關注的是匯率或殖利率變動的速度與幅度，而非鎖定某一特定水準。
這一表態延續了日本官員長期以來對債市溝通的高度重視，尤其是在日本國債殖利率近期升至多年高點的背景下，顯得尤為關鍵
專家指出，再通膨主義通常意味著透過積極財政刺激與貨幣寬鬆來提振成長和物價，市場往往將其與貨幣走弱、債券殖利率上升聯繫在一起，因此這一否認對日元觀察者尤為重要。。
片山也進一步澄清指出，日相高市早苗尊重日本央行的獨立性，日常貨幣政策應由央行自主決定，從而減少外界對財政與貨幣政策協調出現偏差的疑慮，穩定市場對日本政策框架的預期。
在8月美日聯合幹預之後，片山的最新表態增加了對美元兌日元的言語壓力，但在缺乏明確水平指引和具體行動的情況下，交易員可能繼續試探官方的決心，測試干預門檻，進而加劇短期匯率波動。
片山周二雖未點名任何具體水平，但也未宣布任何實際行動，她的措辭始終保持在溝通與協調的熟悉框架內。交易員將密切關注，若日元進一步走弱，官方基調是否會硬化，以及是否會出現與美國財政部的後續接觸或實際干預，未來恐須關注日元匯率走勢、美日後續溝通以及日本財務省是否採取實際行動。
paras_en: The USD/JPY exchange rate traded in a narrow range during today’s (29th) Asian morning session, hovering around 157.35. Japan’s Finance Minister Shunichi Katayama said that yen weakness remains a persistent concern, and that the two sides will maintain close contact to seek to preserve order in the foreign‑exchange market.

Katayama said, “As Ms. Sanae Takaichi noted at the recent Japan‑US summit in New York, I also believe that the yen is undervalued. We will continue close communication between Japanese and US financial authorities and work to keep the FX market orderly.”

Before making the remarks, Katayama had spoken with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen on Friday (the 25th). The two sides reaffirmed their shared concern that the yen is undervalued and agreed to deepen cooperation further.

Earlier, Japan and the United States confirmed in early August that they would carry out a joint intervention to support the yen. Katayama’s latest comments echo Yellen’s view, showing that the two governments are moving toward an even more aligned stance on the yen’s exchange‑rate issue. Both sides not only restated their common worry about yen undervaluation but also confirmed their willingness to continue coordinated communication, sending a clear market signal that Japan and the US are closely synchronized on FX developments and are ready to take coordinated action if needed to preserve rate stability and market order.

Katayama’s latest statement aims to dispel market speculation that the Japanese government is deliberately suppressing the yen to boost inflation. If the market believed the government welcomed a weak yen, downward pressure on the currency would intensify; the explicit denial helps ease such concerns and provides some support to the yen.

She also stressed that interest‑rate levels are ultimately determined by the market, denied that the Takaichi administration pursues “re‑inflationism,” and said the Finance Ministry will stay in close touch with bond‑market participants. The use of the term “orderly” follows official phrasing, indicating that Tokyo is focused on the speed and magnitude of exchange‑rate or yield movements rather than targeting a specific level.

This wording continues the long‑standing emphasis Japanese officials place on bond‑market communication, which is especially critical now that Japanese government‑bond yields have risen to multi‑year highs.

Experts note that “re‑inflationism” typically implies aggressive fiscal stimulus and monetary easing to spur growth and prices, which markets usually associate with a weaker currency and rising bond yields, making the denial particularly significant for yen observers.

Katayama further clarified that Finance Minister Takaichi respects the Bank of Japan’s independence and that daily monetary policy should be set by the central bank, reducing worries about a mismatch between fiscal and monetary policy and stabilising market expectations of Japan’s policy framework.

After the August US‑Japan joint intervention, Katayama’s latest remarks add verbal pressure on the dollar‑yen pair, but without clear level guidance or concrete action traders may continue probing the authorities’ resolve, testing the intervention threshold and potentially heightening short‑term volatility.

Although Katayama did not name any specific level on Tuesday nor announce any concrete steps, her language stayed within the familiar framework of communication and coordination. Traders will watch closely whether a further yen decline leads to a hardening of the official tone, subsequent contacts with the US Treasury, or actual intervention, and will monitor the yen’s trajectory, future Japan‑US dialogue, and any concrete actions by the Finance Ministry.

今年9月3日，美元兌日元跌破連接2025年4月低點的上升趨勢線，隨後反彈回測未果；上周五(25日)在紐約匯市午後一度跌約1%，確認趨勢線失守。
Wald強調，死亡交叉不是精準擇時工具，「每次大跌常始於死亡交叉，但非每次死亡交叉都會大跌」。
歷史樣本分歧明顯：2025年3月交叉後再跌約6%、約一個月觸底；2024年9月交叉後僅再跌1.8%、一周見底，故本周信號宜視為「趨勢反轉確認」，而非跌幅預測。
美國財長貝森特上周五表示，與日本財相片山皋月通話討論「反映日本經濟基本面的強日元可取」，美國總統川普亦認為日元走強符合方向；片山、日本外匯事務官三村淳接連口頭干預，市場解讀華府不再樂見美元兌日元續升。
美日兩國7月底曾聯手買日元，據日本央行(BOJ)數據推算干預規模約870億美元，短期將匯價由163.9推至155附近，但8月又回彈至159上下，顯示聯合操作可壓波動、難改利差根本。
分析認為，技術加華府態度使得日元空頭面臨口頭與實質干預雙重上限，但美日利差、Fed緊縮預期與BOJ升息節奏未變前，152能否守住仍看本周稍晚公布的非農與後續通膨數據。若死亡交叉確認且200日均線持續壓制，中期由漲轉橫或偏弱機率升高；若美債殖利率再上、BOJ偏鴿，則技術信號可能被基本面抵消。
paras_en: Analysts have recently pointed out that the 17-month uptrend in USD/JPY has broken, as the technical chart shows the 50-day moving average falling below the 200-day moving average, potentially forming a "death cross" as early as this week – the first since March 25, 2025.

Ari Wald, head of technical analysis at the well-known U.S. investment bank Oppenheimer, noted that after USD/JPY fails to hold the 200-day moving average, the next move may test support near 152, close to the 2026 low.

On September 3 of this year, USD/JPY broke below the upward trend line connecting the April 2025 low, then rebounded but failed to retest; last Friday (the 25th) it fell about 1% in the New York forex market in the afternoon, confirming the trend line was broken.
Wald emphasized that a death cross is not a precise timing tool – "every major drop often starts with a death cross, but not every death cross leads to a big drop."

Historical samples show clear divergence: after the March 2025 cross, the pair fell about 6% and hit a bottom in roughly a month; after the September 2024 cross, it fell only 1.8% and bottomed in a week. Thus, the signal this week should be viewed as a confirmation of a trend reversal rather than a prediction of a decline.

U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen said last Friday that she discussed with Japanese Finance Minister Yoshihide Suga the idea that a strong yen reflecting Japan’s economic fundamentals is desirable. President Trump also believes a stronger yen aligns with the direction. Suga and Japanese foreign exchange official Jun Muramura repeatedly intervened verbally, leading the market to interpret that Washington no longer welcomes a continued rise in USD/JPY.

In late July, the U.S. and Japan jointly bought yen. According to BOJ data, the intervention was roughly $87 billion, temporarily pushing the rate from 163.9 to around 155. However, in August it rebounded to about 159, showing that joint operations can curb volatility but cannot fundamentally alter the interest rate spread.

Analysts believe that technical factors combined with Washington’s stance put a dual ceiling on the yen’s shortfall, both verbally and materially. Yet with the U.S.-Japan interest rate differential, Fed tightening expectations, and BOJ’s unchanged rate hike pace, whether 152 can hold remains to be seen in the non‑farm payroll and subsequent inflation data to be released later this week. If the death cross is confirmed and the 200‑day moving average continues to suppress, the probability of a shift from a rise to a sideways or weaker trend increases. If U.S. Treasury yields rise further and the BOJ remains dovish, the technical signal may be offset by fundamentals.

items.title: 去槓桿風暴將至！美銀Hartnett：兩大指標即將觸發拋售信號
items.title_en: Deleveraging Storm Approaches! BofA's Hartnett: Two Key Indicators Set to Trigger Sell Signals
paras: 美銀首席策略師Michael Hartnett在最新《Flow Show》報告中警告，若衡量美債波動的MOVE指數與全球金融股同步發出特定信號，美股恐面臨劇烈的風險偏好驟降與去槓桿壓力。
他設定了明確的觀察指標：當MOVE指數攀升至125以上，且iShares全球金融ETF(IXG)跌破125美元時，市場可能觸發「避險去槓桿事件」。
近期債市波動顯著加劇，MOVE指數在兩日內飆升33%，10年債殖利率更上升至19年來高位。隨著通膨預期升溫及Fed鷹派預期，債券價格承壓。
Hartnett指出，關鍵在於債市壓力是否傳導至金融股。由於金融機構對利率與融資環境高度敏感，金融股走弱將成為市場壓力擴大的第二道確認信號。
根據Hartnett分析，若美債殖利率持續走高並伴隨IXG破位，市場將從局部資產重新定價轉向廣泛的風險削減，引發連鎖拋售。即便出現美伊達成協議導致油價大跌的情境，只要殖利率漲勢不止，避險情緒仍難消退。
對於未來政策走向，Hartnett認為，當市場壓力達到極限，決策官員恐介入壓低油價與收益率。Hartnett預估，若未來一年美債殖利率下降100個基點，長債價格將顯著反彈，屆時投資者應「小幅增持債券」。此前Hartnett曾稱，當決策官員開始恐慌，市場就會停止恐慌」。
paras_en: BofA chief strategist Michael Hartnett warned in the latest Flow Show report that if the MOVE index, which measures US Treasury volatility, and global financial stocks simultaneously emit a specific signal, US equities could face a sharp drop in risk appetite and deleveraging pressure.
He set clear watch‑points: when the MOVE index climbs above 125 and the iShares Global Financial ETF (IXG) falls below $125, the market may trigger a ‘hedge‑driven deleveraging event’.

Recent bond‑market volatility has surged dramatically, with the MOVE index jumping 33% over two days and the 10‑year Treasury yield rising to its highest level in 19 years. Rising inflation expectations and hawkish Fed outlook are putting pressure on bond prices.

Hartnett noted that the key is whether bond‑market stress transmits to financial stocks. Because financial institutions are highly sensitive to rates and financing conditions, a weakening in financial stocks would serve as a second confirmation signal of expanding market pressure.

According to Hartnett’s analysis, if US Treasury yields keep climbing and IXG breaks down, the market will shift from localized asset repricing to broad risk reduction, sparking a cascade of sell‑offs. Even a scenario where a US‑Iran agreement drives oil prices sharply lower won’t quell hedging sentiment as long as yields keep rising.

Regarding future policy direction, Hartnett believes that when market stress reaches its limit, policymakers may step in to push down oil prices and yields. He estimates that if US Treasury yields fall by 100 basis points over the next year, long‑bond prices will rebound markedly, and investors should ‘slightly increase bond holdings’. Hartnett previously said that when policymakers start to panic, the market will stop panicking.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元持平 美伊僵局推升油價與美債殖利率
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Flat as US‑Iran Standoff Boosts Oil Prices and US Treasury Yields
paras: 美元周一(28日)兌主要貨幣大致持平。由於美國與伊朗持續陷入僵局，油價走高，同時，美國公債市場的拋售重新出現，推升了殖利率。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)持平於101.19，仍接近兩個月高點。
美國公債殖利率仍維持在5%以上，處於數十年來高點。不過，由於中東局勢長期陷入僵局，美元市場情緒仍受到壓力。這場危機已經妨礙石油與天然氣經由荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)運輸。
歐元兌美元持平於1.1383美元，徘徊在兩個月低點附近。英鎊兌美元也持平於1.3256美元，但仍接近三個月來的低點。
Bannockburn Forex首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler表示，「現在的情況是，美國拒絕了伊朗提出的方案，而油價因此跳升，進一步推高美國公債殖利率，而這正是推動美元整體走強的因素。」
布蘭特原油期貨上漲超過3%，突破每桶 107美元，此前美國總統川普拒絕伊朗提出的和平協議。
能源供應風險及美國經濟基本面的強勁表現，加劇了市場對通膨的擔憂，也促使交易員押注聯準會(Fed)將採取更鷹派的政策。此外，長天期美國公債殖利率上升，也對美元形成支撐。
日本主管外匯事務最高官員三村淳(Atsushi Mimura)周一表示，市場應該認真看待東京與華盛頓對日元走弱所表達的「非常明確」擔憂。
日元在亞洲交易時段一度小幅升值，但之後回吐部分漲幅，最新來到1美元兌157日元，日元下跌約0.12%。
Chandler表示，「日本官員不能兩邊都要：他們不能一方面面對伊朗戰爭推高油價與美國公債殖利率，另一方面又試圖限制美元兌日元的升幅。在我的分析中，美元兌日元走勢是受到美國利率上升所推動。我認為現在形成的是一場拉鋸戰：一方面，日本官員透過口頭干預，宣稱獲得美國支持，另一方面，美國公債殖利率持續上升。」
接下來公布的經濟數據，包括周三的PCE物價指數及周五的非農就業報告，市場預期兩者都將支持進一步收緊貨幣政策的可能性。
此外，市場也預期澳洲央行(RBA)周二將升息25個基點，使利率升至4.60%，創下接近15年來新高。
澳幣兌美元下跌0.07%，至0.7018美元。
紐幣兌美元則上升0.18%，至0.5664美元。
離岸人民幣兌美元小幅升值至6.715。此前，川普與中國國家主席習近平進行了為期三天的峰會，但在一系列爭議問題上，並未取得重大突破。

paras_en: The dollar was roughly flat against major currencies on Monday (the 28th). As the US and Iran remain deadlocked, oil prices rose, and a sell‑off in US Treasury bonds re‑emerged, pushing yields higher.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, was flat at 101.19, still near a two‑month high.

US Treasury yields stayed above 5%, at multi‑decade highs. However, with the Middle‑East stalemate persisting, sentiment in the dollar market remains under pressure. The crisis has already disrupted oil and gas shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.
The euro was flat at $1.1383, hovering near a two‑month low. The pound was also flat at $1.3256, still close to a three‑month low.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Forex, said, “The situation now is that the US has rejected Iran’s proposal, oil prices have jumped, further lifting US Treasury yields, and that is what is driving the overall strength of the dollar.”
Brent crude futures rose more than 3% to break above $107 a barrel after US President Trump rejected Iran’s peace proposal.

Supply‑risk concerns in energy and the strong fundamentals of the US economy have heightened inflation worries and prompted traders to bet that the Fed will adopt a more hawkish stance. In addition, the rise in long‑term US Treasury yields has also supported the dollar.

Atsushi Mimura, Japan’s top official for foreign‑exchange affairs, said on Monday that markets should take seriously the “very clear” concerns expressed by Tokyo and Washington about the yen’s weakness.
The yen briefly appreciated during the Asian trading session but then gave back some of the gains, now at ¥157 per $1, down about 0.12%.

Chandler added, “Japanese officials can’t have it both ways: they can’t on the one hand point to the Iran‑related war driving oil prices and US Treasury yields higher, and on the other try to cap the dollar‑yen rise. In my view the USD/JPY move is driven by rising US rates. I see a tug‑of‑war forming: Japanese officials are verbally intervening, claiming US support, while US Treasury yields keep climbing.”
Upcoming data releases, including Wednesday’s PCE price index and Friday’s non‑farm payrolls, are expected to both support the case for further monetary tightening.
The market also expects the Reserve Bank of Australia to raise rates by 25 basis points on Tuesday, taking the cash rate to 4.60%, a near‑15‑year high.
The Australian dollar fell 0.07% to $0.7018.
The New Zealand dollar rose 0.18% to $0.5664.

Offshore yuan inched higher to 6.715 per dollar. Earlier, Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping held a three‑day summit, but failed to achieve any major breakthroughs on a series of contentious issues.
